documents.title: Boneyard Wastes Diary
documents.snippet: Sun-bleached desert, ancient pyramids, and the bone-roads where Azhmari once ruled. Skeletons, sand crabs, and dust devils stand between you and the deep tomb.

documents.title: Glass Desert Diary
documents.snippet: An inland sea of fused crystal where the old sun shattered. Veldrak coils in the sandstorm, and the Crystal Wyrm hunts through the prism dunes. The endgame's final region.

documents.title: Heartlands Diary
documents.snippet: The starter region. From mining copper in the eastern hills to slaying greater demons in the deepest dungeon.

documents.title: Inkweald Diary
documents.snippet: A dreamscape forest of black ink and lucid silence. Reality stretches; dreams have edges. The Hollow Choir sings beneath the resonance chamber.

documents.title: Moryskah Diary
documents.snippet: Bog, blood, and barrows. Vampyres roam the canopy and ghasts pull travellers off the path. Bring silver, holy water, and a strong stomach.

documents.title: Saltbrine Reach Diary
documents.snippet: Harbour towns, pirate coves, and the long Saltbrine Trawler. The deep wakes Krakens and worse — but the lobster catch is the best in Aelgard.

documents.title: Sootworks Diary
documents.snippet: Dwarven forge-city of pipework, blast furnaces, and rune-bound steel. The Soot King reigns from the deep vein. Bring a stout, your best pickaxe, and a tolerance for ash.

documents.title: Veilwood Diary
documents.snippet: Old-growth forest layered with elven roads and druidic groves. Stormwoods only release their logs in lightning. The Veilmother sleeps beneath the deepest grove.

documents.title: Salted King — Trial Combat
documents.snippet: The Salted King comes back every hour at the prayer-stone. He does not fight like a man. He fights like the memory of one. The bone-bound iron is what he fears.

documents.title: [Quirky] Kick the Scarecrow
documents.snippet: Kick the farm scarecrow repeatedly. Gives the tiniest attack XP. The farmer watches, bemused.

documents.title: Mirror Glade — Fighting What You Were
documents.snippet: You fight your reflection. It knows your openings before you do. Marstead — you must be everything.

documents.title: Sleeper Trails — Named-Things-That-Shouldn't-Be-Named
documents.snippet: Walk the trail. Kill what the forest names at you. Forget it immediately. Pages pile in your bag.

documents.title: Scorpion Combat
documents.snippet: Scorpions in the dunes. Solid attack training. Carapaces craft into light armor.

documents.title: Metal Dragon Hunting
documents.snippet: Iron + steel dragons. Premium dragon bones + rare visage (1/5000).

documents.title: Pirate Ship Boarding
documents.snippet: Board pirate ships. Combat + loot. Unique deck-fighting mechanics.

documents.title: Vampire Thrall Slaying
documents.snippet: Slay vampire thralls in the crypts. Silver weapons required. Blood vials feed herblore/RC.

documents.title: Ghoul Catacomb Combat
documents.snippet: Low-level ghouls in catacombs. Great early Moryskah attack training. Bones feed prayer.

documents.title: Barrows Brother Grinding
documents.snippet: Repeatable Barrows runs. Highest Moryskah attack XP. Iconic prestige content.

documents.title: Vampire Noble Elite Combat
documents.snippet: Elite vampire nobles in Castle Malachar. Endgame Moryskah combat. Vampire-slaying flail required.

documents.title: [Quirky] Guard Practice Dummy
documents.snippet: Swing at the practice dummy. Each hit gives minimal attack XP.

documents.title: Crystal Wyrm Grinding
documents.snippet: Crystal Wyrm. Tier-5 prestige boss. Best endgame melee XP + profit.

documents.title: Revenant Weapon Hunting
documents.snippet: Revenant caves. Extreme PKer threat. Highest combat profit + XP. Revenant weapons are BIS in wilds.

documents.title: Chicken Slaughter
documents.snippet: Auto-retaliate on chickens. Feathers sell to fletchers. The gentlest start.

documents.title: Cow Field Training
documents.snippet: Cows near the bank. Hides are valuable early on for crafting.

documents.title: Sand Crab AFKing
documents.snippet: AFK multi-combat crabs. Reset aggro every 10 minutes. Zero profit, pure XP.

documents.title: Slayer Task Melee
documents.snippet: Train attack on slayer assignments. Varied tasks keep it interesting and profitable.

documents.title: Nightmare Zone Melee
documents.snippet: Absorption potions and overloads turn this into semi-AFK high XP. Costs entry fee.

documents.title: Revenant Hunting (Melee)
documents.snippet: High profit revenants in deep Wilds. PKers are the real threat. Bring 3-item risk.

documents.title: Hidden Court Duelist Matches
documents.snippet: Spar the court duelists. First-to-three, no killing blows. Courtly, attentive, won — blade by blade.

documents.title: Vine-Haunt Pruning
documents.snippet: Prune the grasping vines. Secateurs — required, sharp. Good early attack XP. Brambles trap-craft.

documents.title: Glass-Stag Hunter's Combat
documents.snippet: Track the glass-stag. Three paces; strike; apologise; track again. High XP, high stakes — miss, and the herd hides a week.

documents.title: Edgeward Ditch PvP Drill
documents.snippet: The first ditch. Twenty tiles from safety. Drill attack against the level-ones who wandered too far. PvP risk multiplier applied to all XP.

documents.title: Revenant Hellhound Melee
documents.snippet: Grave-mile revenants. Melee with Viggora charged against the hellhound pack. PKers will come. Logout tabs ready. Ether rains when they do not.

documents.title: King Black Dragon — Lair Combat
documents.snippet: King Black Dragon. Level-fourteen wilderness lair entrance; teleblocked pocket below. Three heads, three breaths, one key-item drop per run.

documents.title: Vet'ion — Skeleton Champion Grind
documents.snippet: Vet'ion. Deep teleblocked wilds. Two phases, four skeletons summoned per phase. Drops Ring of the Long Road — teleport delay reduced two ticks.

documents.title: Mithril Dragons Pocket Combat
documents.snippet: Mithril dragons in the teleblocked pocket. Level-thirty wilderness. Crossbow-bolt drop table at PKer-frequency. The scales craft into dragonhide wards.

documents.title: [Quirky] Empty the Dry Well
documents.snippet: Haul buckets of sand from the dry well. It has been dry for a hundred years. The hermit insists that one day it will come back.

documents.title: Edge-Keeper Trial — Strength
documents.snippet: Trial of the Edge-Keeper. Cut. Hold. Cut again. The keeper watches. The keeper does not forget. BiS endgame strength.

documents.title: Wyrm-Spawn Cleave
documents.snippet: Cleave wyrm-spawn as they hatch from the lair-stone. They do not scream. They only shatter.

documents.title: [Quirky] Haul the Well Bucket
documents.snippet: Haul a heavy bucket up the village well. Tiny strength XP per lift. Produces water.

documents.title: [Quirky] Ring the Church Bell
documents.snippet: Pull the church bell rope. Heavy work. The priest tolerates it for a few hours a day.

documents.title: [Quirky] Pull the Chapel Bell-Rope
documents.snippet: The chapel bell-rope is lighter than the tower one. Father Dorin lets anyone pull it. A pinch of strength per pull.

documents.title: [Quirky] Work the Milk Churn
documents.snippet: The dairymaid leaves the churn out when she fetches wood. Working the handle gives a flutter of strength. She comes back with cider.

documents.title: The Noon Bell Chorus
documents.snippet: Ring the fallen bell with the Rancher Bell tied against it, fresh fibers in hand, sachet of ash at your neck. ONLY works from 11:55 to 12:05 in-game time. Miss the chorus, waste the day.

documents.title: Mirror Glade — Overpowering What You Were
documents.snippet: You out-lift the version of you who hasn't slept well. It doesn't go easy. Neither do you.

documents.title: Cradlewood Log Hauling
documents.snippet: Carry singing-soft logs to the clearing. They grow heavier the longer you remember the song.

documents.title: [Quirky] Shovel the Sand Drifts
documents.snippet: Shovel endless sand drifts. Occasionally uncovers buried trinkets.

documents.title: Moss Giant Smashing
documents.snippet: Moss giants in the glades. Safe, profitable, feeds prayer via big bones.

documents.title: Crypt Raider Strength
documents.snippet: Aggressive style in the cursed crypts. Tombstone rubble feeds construction.

documents.title: [Quirky] Dig Graves for the Sexton
documents.snippet: Dig fresh graves for the sexton. Strength XP per shovelful. Occasionally uncover forgotten bones.

documents.title: [Quirky] The Village Pump
documents.snippet: Pump handle at the village well. Each pump gives the slightest strength XP.

documents.title: [Quirky] Pull the Pressure Lever
documents.snippet: Pull the massive pressure-release lever. Heavy. Unsatisfying.

documents.title: [Quirky] Pump the Cathedral Bellows
documents.snippet: Work the Forge Cathedral bellows. Arm burns. The smiths nod. Tiny strength XP.

documents.title: Capstan & Cable Hauling
documents.snippet: Four men at the capstan; five ropes rising. You walk the wheel. The bosun counts the turns. She pays by the ton weighed.

documents.title: Lobstrosity Crushing
documents.snippet: The shell yields only to crush. Strength XP from the breaking. Lobstrosity flesh into the galley stew.

documents.title: [Quirky] Pump the Bilge
documents.snippet: Two men on the pump, one on the discharge. The bilge rises — you pump her down. Strength in the shoulders. The boat does not thank you.

documents.title: Furnace-Chant Hammer Drills
documents.snippet: Beat the chant-anvil until the Cinderbar sings. Dwarven strength drill. Warm. Safe. AFK.

documents.title: Slag-Tunnel Haul
documents.snippet: Haul slag ore carts up the tunnel. Push, brace, lock the wheel. Strength + haulage pay.

documents.title: Wilderness Boss Hunting
documents.snippet: Callisto / Venenatis / Vetion. Wilderness bosses. Extreme risk — PKers hunt you while you hunt bosses.

documents.title: Sand Crab Strength
documents.snippet: AFK crabs on aggressive style. Pure XP, zero engagement, zero profit.

documents.title: Hill Giant Bashing
documents.snippet: Big bone drops fund prayer training. A classic early grind with real output. The resource advantage over crabs.

documents.title: Obsidian Sword Training
documents.snippet: Full obsidian with berserker necklace. Semi-AFK training at NMZ or crabs.

documents.title: Wilderness Boss Grinding
documents.snippet: Wilderness bosses hit hard and PKers lurk. Huge profit justifies extreme risk.

documents.title: Barbarian Assault (Attacker)
documents.snippet: Team minigame with role-based combat. High engagement, unique rewards, free.

documents.title: Threshold-Warden Strength Trials
documents.snippet: Hold the threshold while three wardens press. Shoulder set; stance held; line kept — by the third bell, passed.

documents.title: Chaos Fanatic — Strength Grind
documents.snippet: Chaos Fanatic. Level-forty wilds. He hits random magic. Your strength carries the fight. PKers attack during his magic phase — watch the ditch count.

documents.title: Revenant Demon Crush
documents.snippet: No-honor revenants. The demon strain. Strength per swing is the highest in the wilds. Teleblocked deep means twenty-three tiles from safety minimum.

documents.title: Scorpia — Wilderness Slaying
documents.snippet: Scorpia. Level-fifty wilderness den. The offspring she drops follows you, fights with you. Only wilds boss that grants a combat familiar.

documents.title: The Exiled Champion — Instance Fight
documents.snippet: The Exiled Champion. Instance inside the Exiled Camp — safe pocket in deep wilds. His blade is the original. He carries a piece of the blade you will inherit.

documents.title: Sand-Warden Drill
documents.snippet: Stand the watch at the sand-warden post where the wind has a number. Salt-chapped but steady. The drills that teach a body to hold its ground before the dunes.

documents.title: Bones of Fallen Kings — Defensive Trial
documents.snippet: Defensive trials among the bones of kings long-fallen, where every name is still spoken by the wind. Shards smith into bone-bound iron.

documents.title: Edge-Keeper Trial — Defence
documents.snippet: Brace against the Keeper's first strike. It is the only one that matters. Stance. Hold. Know.

documents.title: Glass-Stalker Wardening
documents.snippet: Ward the unseen. Glass-stalkers do not warn. The shield hears them before the eye does.

documents.title: Guard Patrol Drills
documents.snippet: Patrol the Heartlands walls with the guard corps. Defensive stance. Boring but safe.

documents.title: Noble Bodyguard Work
documents.snippet: Escort Heartlands nobles between guilds. Occasional assassination attempts provide combat practice.

documents.title: Crown Courier Escort
documents.snippet: Courier circuits only start once per hour on the half. All three sashes must be worn in order (innermost red, middle white, outer blue). Ambushers strike twice a run. Keep moving.

documents.title: Mirror Glade — Refusing What You Were
documents.snippet: You refuse the hit your reflection was always going to land. Every block teaches you something.

documents.title: Sleepwalker Ward-Stance
documents.snippet: Stand between the sleepwalkers and the waking. Let them walk through you. Learn what doesn't wake them.

documents.title: Cursed Knight Defensive
documents.snippet: Cursed knights in the Moryskah ruins. Armor scraps smith into high-tier gothic armor.

documents.title: Heat-Temper Plate Drills
documents.snippet: Stand under the drop-forge while it quenches. The plate learns. You learn. Forge Cathedral.

documents.title: Golem-Spawn Wardening
documents.snippet: Ward the Slag Tunnels while golem-spawn hammer your shield. Block. Stance. Hold.

documents.title: Sand Crab Defence
documents.snippet: Defensive style on crabs. Slowest combat XP but completely AFK.

documents.title: Castle Wars Defence Training
documents.snippet: AFK at Castle Wars on defensive. Free, earns tickets, no food needed. Low-level AFK defence option.

documents.title: Slayer on Defensive
documents.snippet: Slayer tasks on defensive. Slower kills but profitable and varied.

documents.title: Chinchompa Defence Stacking
documents.snippet: Chin monkey stacking on long-range. Absurdly fast but costs a fortune per hour.

documents.title: Pest Control (Defence)
documents.snippet: Team minigame. Medium engagement, free, earns void knight equipment.

documents.title: Abyss Defence Training
documents.snippet: Multi-combat abyss creatures. Good XP, skull risk entering. Bring cheap gear.

documents.title: Threshold-Warden Combat Trials
documents.snippet: Stand the threshold. Step not. Wardens test: melee, ranged, spell — endured, all three.

documents.title: Mirror-Stag Ward Duel
documents.snippet: The mirror-stag reflects what it meets. Attack soft; be attacked. Shield work rewarded — unique defensive XP.

documents.title: Inner Sanctum Trial-of-Kin
documents.snippet: Trial-of-Kin in the Inner Sanctum. Three kin stand; one speaks; held, one line. End-game defensive XP.

documents.title: Greater Demon Defence Grind
documents.snippet: Skull-gold ruins. Greater demons in groups of four. Defence XP faster than safe-zone greaters. PKer ambush rate: medium. Watch the long road.

documents.title: Callisto — Defensive Bearhunt
documents.snippet: Callisto. No-honor ridge. The bear-of-the-long-road. Defensive solo kills. No-honor amulet drops here. The bear does not care about the ditch count.

documents.title: Dark Warrior Elite — Tank Grind
documents.snippet: Dark warriors. Level-fourteen wilds. Elite tier at the castle. Defence XP at greater-demon rate. PKers camp the castle stairs.

documents.title: Veiled Grave Meditation Ward
documents.snippet: Lie down inside the Veiled Grave and let the chapped lips of the desert teach the body to endure. Pure HP training. The keepers ask for one jar of water per hour.

documents.title: Bones of Fallen Kings — Hitpoints Trial
documents.snippet: Endure the king-ghosts' measured blows among the prayer-stones. Each strike is a lesson the body does not forget.

documents.title: [Quirky] Endure Salt-Chapped Lips
documents.snippet: Sit at the noon bell with the sun on your mouth. Salt-chapped, sun-blackened, and the body learns what it can take. Tiny HP XP.

documents.title: Edge-Keeper Trial — Hitpoints
documents.snippet: Stand the trial. Take the edge. Heal. Stand again. The body learns what the mind will not say.

documents.title: Witness Wall Endurance Vigil
documents.snippet: Stand the vigil at the Witness Wall. The desert witnesses. The desert grants. AFK HP at endgame tier.

documents.title: Infirmary Practice Ward
documents.snippet: Practice taking damage at the Apothecary infirmary. Healers patch you up. Pure HP training.

documents.title: [World Event] The First Bell
documents.snippet: On completing the Coronation, every village well in Heartlands gains a bell. Ringing a well bell at noon grants a tiny region-wide XP bonus for the next in-game hour.

documents.title: [World Event] The Lamplighter Census
documents.snippet: A rolling census of every lantern across Aelgard. Players who visit a lamp and relight it get a stamped census booklet. Full booklet (all 6 regions) unlocks the Census Cape.

documents.title: [World Event] The Reagent Road Opens
documents.snippet: 23 hidden reagent caches open across Aelgard. A new NPC (the Road Warden) walks between them. If you clear all 23 in a single in-game week, the Grand Tonic recipe becomes permanent at your Apothecary.

documents.title: [World Event] The Dragon Tithe Season
documents.snippet: The Deepkeep opens for one in-game week every season. During the week, wyvern hunts grant 2x XP and the Tithe Cape upgrades each time a new visage is donated. Four seasons = Fully Gilded Tithe Cape.

documents.title: [World Event] The Hedge Answers
documents.snippet: On the anniversary of the player's birth-name recording, the old hedge speaks once. A short cryptic message drops into the journal. Each anniversary yields a new piece of an unfinished poem.

documents.title: Dreamless Rest at the Threshold
documents.snippet: Sleep without dreaming on the threshold stones. Your body remembers how to be a body.

documents.title: Mirror Glade — Being Hit by Yourself
documents.snippet: Take the hits you always land. Your reflection knows how. You're going to learn.

documents.title: Banshee Screaming Tower
documents.snippet: AFK banshees while they scream at you. Passive HP. Requires earmuffs.

documents.title: Rock-Crab Tanking
documents.snippet: Stand between the coastal rock-crabs. They step on you for twenty minutes. You step back. She pays in small ticks.

documents.title: Siren-Rock Endurance
documents.snippet: Take the siren-song on the rocks with ears plugged. She sings. She does not reach you. HP accrues in the waiting.

documents.title: Boil-Floor Heat Bath
documents.snippet: Sit on the Boil-Floor while the steam works your lungs. Passive HP. Mind the cinder.

documents.title: Pipehound Grappling Pit
documents.snippet: Wrestle pipehounds in the grappling pit. They bite shallow. Cinderbar-handled leash required.

documents.title: Passive Combat HP
documents.snippet: HP XP comes free with any combat. AFK anything and HP ticks up.

documents.title: NMZ Absorption HP
documents.snippet: Absorption potions soak damage while you accumulate passive HP XP.

documents.title: Slayer HP Training
documents.snippet: HP XP from slayer tasks. Profitable and varied, standard mid-game path.

documents.title: Raid Boss HP
documents.snippet: Raid bosses demand maximum focus. HP XP is a byproduct of the real challenge.

documents.title: Green Dragons (HP)
documents.snippet: Great profit from bones and hides. PKer risk keeps most people away.

documents.title: Songbird Sparring Ward
documents.snippet: The forest sings; you bleed a little. Elven healers patch you. AFK hitpoints, the gentle way.

documents.title: Glass-Spider Hollow Endurance
documents.snippet: Tank the glass-spider swarm. Venom chips; silk drops. Passive HP with real drops — not miserable, not idle.

documents.title: Mirror-Stag Ward Parlay
documents.snippet: Trade soft blows with the mirror-stag; reflect the hardest ones yourself. Elite HP. Dream-ranged drops.

documents.title: Edgeward Ditch HP Grind
documents.snippet: First ditch. Take hits from the rev-imps and learn the ditch count. Twenty tiles from the wall. HP per tick the same as attack per swing.

documents.title: Venenatis — HP Trial
documents.snippet: Venenatis. Spider-queen of the third-ditch. Her webs do half your HP per tick. Each kill is a hitpoints lesson; the body remembers the bite.

documents.title: [Quirky] Spit in the Ditch
documents.snippet: Spit in the ditch before you cross. It is the only honesty the wilds will accept. Tiny HP XP. The ditch does not spit back.

documents.title: The Teleblocked King — Throne Fight
documents.snippet: The Teleblocked King. Throne of the Wilds. He teleblocks at any HP above 10%. No escape while he draws breath. Prestige boss. Wilderness Crown drop.

documents.title: Salt Sea Boomerang Range
documents.snippet: Throwing at the Salt Sea Range, where the targets walk the dune chain and the boomerang chains between them. Returns eighty of a hundred. The other twenty the sand keeps.

documents.title: Witness Range — Prism-Shot Drill
documents.snippet: Loose the prism-shot. It chains. Three targets, one string-pull. The desert teaches economy.

documents.title: Witness Range — Light-Arrow Master
documents.snippet: The arrow holds its own light. No wind. No drop. Target. Release. Witness. BiS endgame ranged.

documents.title: Half-Light Range Practice
documents.snippet: Aim at what-was-aimed-at. The target is always half-missed; the XP is full.

documents.title: Dream-Arrow Volley
documents.snippet: Loose dream-arrows at the Half-Light targets. They land where you meant to aim, even when you didn't.

documents.title: Sand Serpent Hunting
documents.snippet: Pick off sand serpents. Fangs feed herblore (weapon poison).

documents.title: Shade Shooting
documents.snippet: Pick off shades with silver bolts. Remains feed the pyre-prayer path.

documents.title: [Quirky] Elven Archery Targets
documents.snippet: Practice on the elven target range. They mock your aim.

documents.title: Crow's Nest Sniper Range
documents.snippet: From the crow's nest — storm-sway factored, the shot compensates. Highest-attention ranged in Aelgard. The rigging does not forgive loose feet.

documents.title: Harbour Archery Practice
documents.snippet: Dockside straw butts. Quiet practice. The harbour-master allows it if you retrieve your own arrows. Most do not.

documents.title: Tinker-Yard Crossbow Range
documents.snippet: Drop-cast crossbow drills at the Tinker Yards. Bolts come off stamped. Crack. Wind. Fire.

documents.title: Shot-Cast Munitions Line
documents.snippet: Feed the shot-cast line. Rate-of-fire drills. Extreme ranged XP but the munitions bill is real.

documents.title: Fight Caves Progression
documents.snippet: The Fight Caves. 63 waves. Earns Fire Cape — prestige item, also entry to Inferno.

documents.title: Inferno Progression
documents.snippet: The Inferno. 69 waves. Hardest content in Aelgard. Infernal Cape = ultimate prestige.

documents.title: Ogre Safespot
documents.snippet: Safespot ogres behind a fence. Arrow cost is the only expense. Relaxed.

documents.title: Sand Crab Ranging
documents.snippet: Iron arrows on crabs. AFK ranged with minor ammo cost.

documents.title: NMZ Blowpipe AFK
documents.snippet: Blowpipe at NMZ with absorption potions. AFK ranged training at 60+. Scale cost adds up.

documents.title: Chinchompa Stacking
documents.snippet: AoE chinchompas on stacked monkeys. The fastest ranged XP in the game. Extremely expensive.

documents.title: Cannon + Slayer
documents.snippet: Cannon accelerates slayer kills. Expensive but profitable from drops. The balanced path.

documents.title: Black Chin Hunting + Ranging
documents.snippet: Hunt and use black chins in the Wilds. Massive profit but PKers camp the spot.

documents.title: Veilwood Range — Singing-Arrow Drills
documents.snippet: The range hums when the arrow sings true. Pure ranged training — target-straw dummies, no combat.

documents.title: Moonhawk Sky-Line Hunt
documents.snippet: Shoot moonhawks mid-dive. Lead the wing; not the eye. Top ranged XP tied to unique feather drops — scout-scroll economy downstream.

documents.title: Craw's Bow — Revenant Range
documents.snippet: Craw's bow. +50% accuracy and damage inside the wilderness. Revenant range. Logout tab on one, glory on two, teleblock detection on the belt.

documents.title: Crazy Archaeologist — Ranged Grind
documents.snippet: Crazy Archaeologist. Skull-gold ruins south. His books. Your bow. The distance is five tiles. He teleblocks at thirty percent HP. Have a logout tab.

documents.title: Morrigan's Throw — Deep Range
documents.snippet: Morrigan's javelin. It bleeds twenty-five percent max HP per hit. Degrades on death. Peak ranged XP in Aelgard. Peak wilds danger.

documents.title: Revenant Cave — Black Chinchompa AoE
documents.snippet: Black chinchompas into the revenant pack. Cave multicombat. Peak ranged XP in Aelgard at peak cost. Teleblocked by the first rev that sees you.

documents.title: Veiled Grave — Anti-Undead Chants
documents.snippet: Chant the anti-undead rites over the sand-mummy linen. Each chant binds one prayer-stone. The keepers grant water-blessing at the end.

documents.title: Water-Blessing Rites
documents.snippet: Bless the cactus-water at the grave with a prayer-stone held over the mouth. One vial cures any poison and halts sand-mummy attacks for fifteen ticks.

documents.title: [Quirky] Read the Bone-Pile
documents.snippet: Read the names on the bones in the bone-pile. Each name you speak is a tiny prayer. The wind collects what you drop.

documents.title: Witness Wall Light-Warding
documents.snippet: Carve the sigil. Offer it at the Wall. The Wall does not answer. It witnesses. 3.5x prayer per sigil. Flagship endgame prayer.

documents.title: Edge-Keeper Relic Offering
documents.snippet: Offer edge-keeper relic with dragon bone. The edge is held. The edge is held. BiS endgame prayer rate.

documents.title: [Quirky] Witness the Edge
documents.snippet: Stand at the Witness Wall. Watch the edge the wall carves in the light. Tiny prayer. The wall sees.

documents.title: [Quirky] Ring the Rancher Bell at Noon
documents.snippet: The Rancher Bell is meant to call herds home. If you ring it at in-game noon, you feel a small blessing. The cows stare at you.

documents.title: [Quirky] Lay Wildflowers on Gravestones
documents.snippet: The small graveyard behind the chapel has unmarked stones. Laying wildflowers gives a gentle prayer trickle. The hedge-wise women nod when you pass.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Coronation quest replay — bonus prayer X
documents.snippet: Coronation quest replay — bonus prayer XP for the throne-room vigil

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Vigil replay — dawn candles at the Chape
documents.snippet: Vigil replay — dawn candles at the Chapel

documents.title: Grand Cathedral Offerings
documents.snippet: Offer bones on the gilded altar of the Grand Cathedral. Dawn wax amplifies the blessing. Fastest prayer in Aelgard.

documents.title: The Dawn Vigil
documents.snippet: Light dawn candles from 04:45 to 05:15 in-game, sign the ledger in birth-name ink, offer dragon bones on each candle. The hedge-wise women must have written your name first. Sprint through it.

documents.title: Threshold of Names — Dream-Warding
documents.snippet: Name what you will not name. Each unsaid name burns one bone. Prayer XP climbs at the rate of silence.

documents.title: [Quirky] Forget Your Own Name at the Threshold
documents.snippet: Stand at the Threshold. Say your name. Forget it. Remember it. Small prayer XP, substantial unease.

documents.title: Fossil Prayer Offering
documents.snippet: Unique Boneyard prayer path. Fossils grant 2.5x the XP of regular bones.

documents.title: Druid Altar Offerings
documents.snippet: Offer bones at the Druid Altar. 3x prayer XP boost vs regular bones.

documents.title: Ectofuntus Worship
documents.snippet: Grind bones + mix with ectoplasm = 4x prayer XP. Moryskah-unique. THE flagship prayer method.

documents.title: Shade Pyre Cremation
documents.snippet: Cremate shades on pyre logs. Double-skill XP (prayer + firemaking). Gothic-flavored sustain.

documents.title: [Quirky] Polish the Altar
documents.snippet: Rub the altar with a cloth. Monks appreciate the dedication.

documents.title: [Quirky] Chant with the Druids
documents.snippet: Join the druids low chant. Repeat the syllables they teach you.

documents.title: [Quirky] Practice Exorcism Chant
documents.snippet: Recite the ancient exorcism phrases. Nothing happens. Probably.

documents.title: [Quirky] Gaze into the Mirror Pool
documents.snippet: Look into your reflection. It looks back slightly wrong.

documents.title: [Quirky] Polish the Sun Prisms
documents.snippet: Polish the great prisms. They redirect sunlight for the shrine.

documents.title: [Quirky] Place a Revenant Ward
documents.snippet: Stake a holy ward into the ground. Slight prayer XP per ward.

documents.title: Captain's Bond Offering
documents.snippet: Wrap bones in tarred cordage, speak the Bond. Name the drowned. Walk the prayer-walk across the jetty. The dead hear.

documents.title: Kraken-Warding Chant
documents.snippet: Stand at the harbour-mouth. Chant the old warding, steady cadence. No interruption. The kraken does not come while the chant holds.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sing the Sea-Chanty
documents.snippet: Stand with the dockside choir. Sing the capstan chanty. The old words. The drowned hear. Prayer accrues in the chorus.

documents.title: Brass Choir Sermons
documents.snippet: Offer relics at the pipe-altar while the machine-saint sings. 3x prayer per offering. Industrial prayer flagship.

documents.title: Pilgrim Watchfire Vigil
documents.snippet: Tend the pilgrim watchfire. AFK prayer. Log-fed. Mid-rate, mid-cost, no supervision.

documents.title: [Quirky] Read the Chantbook
documents.snippet: Read the Brass Choir chantbook. Soft prayer ticks. The pipes mutter along.

documents.title: Mirror Pond Meditation
documents.snippet: Meditate at the Mirror Pond. Your reflection grants prayer insight. Obscure method.

documents.title: Chaos Altar Prayer
documents.snippet: Chaos Altar gives 7x prayer XP. Highest in the game. PKers patrol the altar — you WILL be attacked.

documents.title: Regular Bones at Altar
documents.snippet: Buy bones, use on altar. The cheapest entry into prayer. Repetitive but safe.

documents.title: Dragon Bones on Gilded Altar
documents.snippet: Gilded altar gives 350% XP. Fast but drains the bank. The money method.

documents.title: Ectofuntus Worship
documents.snippet: Grind bones, worship. Better XP per bone than gilded but slower per hour. Earns tokens.

documents.title: Chaos Altar (Wilderness)
documents.snippet: 50% chance bones are saved. Best XP/gp in the game. Bring one inventory at a time.

documents.title: Ensouled Head Reanimation
documents.snippet: Reanimate heads and kill them for prayer XP. Cheaper than bones, needs magic levels.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sweep the Threshold
documents.snippet: Sweep the threshold-wardens' stoop. Kin-keeper work, humble. Prayer XP per whisper of dust the forest notices.

documents.title: Threshold Offerings
documents.snippet: Offer bones at Threshold Shrines. Token boosts XP. Early prayer path that respects the door.

documents.title: Chaos Altar Offering
documents.snippet: The Chaos Altar. Level thirty-eight wilderness. Three-point-five times prayer XP — fifty percent chance to consume a bone without XP. Free entry. PKers know it.

documents.title: Lava Dragon Bones on Chaos Altar
documents.snippet: Lava dragon bones. Chaos altar. The bones only drop in the wilds — so all your prayer XP is wilderness-earned. No-honor prayer. Eighty-five XP per bone.

documents.title: Wilds Demonic Ashes Scattering
documents.snippet: Scatter wilds-grade ashes at the ditch line. Triple XP vs regular demonic ashes. The wind carries it across the long road.

documents.title: [Quirky] Loot the Bones of the Fallen
documents.snippet: Bones of who the PKers got this hour. Scatter them. Take a prayer. Tiny prayer XP. The bones remember who owned them.

documents.title: Burnt Library Scroll-Reading
documents.snippet: Decipher sun-burned scroll fragments. The ink binds the chant to the paper before the wind takes it. Three spell-scrolls per character — which three, the library chooses.

documents.title: Prayer-Binding Spellcasting
documents.snippet: Weave prayer and flame together until the two cannot be separated again. Prayer-bound sigils unlock the anti-undead chant at the Veiled Grave.

documents.title: [Quirky] Speak the Wind's Number
documents.snippet: Stand at the prayer-stone and speak each hour's number into the wind. Tiny magic XP. The wind writes it down somewhere.

documents.title: Mirrored Spire — Crystal-Tier Spellcasting
documents.snippet: Crystal-tier spellcasting at the Mirrored Spire. The spire reflects. The spell returns. Cast. Return. Cast.

documents.title: Prism-Burst Combat Cycle
documents.snippet: Burst. Refract. Burst. The chain completes. BiS endgame combat magic. The Spire remembers the pattern.

documents.title: [Quirky] Count the Colors
documents.snippet: Count the seven colors in a prismstalker track. Speak each one. The Spire listens. Tiny magic XP.

documents.title: [Quirky] Read the Spell Tome
documents.snippet: Browse the Heartlands library. Tiny magic XP per page turned.

documents.title: [Quirky] Talk to the Scarecrow
documents.snippet: The scarecrow in the lower field listens patiently. Telling it your problems grants a pinprick of magic XP. Nobody knows why.

documents.title: The Last Light Altar
documents.snippet: Cast sunlit spells on the Chapel's inner altar. The phrase list is a page long; the air tastes of the candles you were raised on.

documents.title: Hedge-Wise Enchanting
documents.snippet: At the hedge-wise cottage, whisker on the left side of the desk, sprig on the right, vial uncorked, pouch open. She will not tell you why the whisker must be on the left.

documents.title: The Library That Reads Back
documents.snippet: Cast dreambinding + illusion from shelves that rearrange your thoughts. Elite Lunar-tier methodology.

documents.title: [Quirky] Read a Page, Then Read It Back
documents.snippet: Open the book. Read one line. Close it. Read it back aloud. The book laughs — or you laugh, hard to say.

documents.title: Dark Wizard Magic Training
documents.snippet: Cast spells on dark wizards. They drop runes back — net-positive rune training.

documents.title: Sea Witch Duels
documents.snippet: Magic duels with sea witches. Unique magic experience — dodge enchanted storms.

documents.title: Aberrant Spectre Magic
documents.snippet: Magic training on aberrant spectres. Herb drop table makes it profitable.

documents.title: [Quirky] Listen to Crypt Whispers
documents.snippet: Press your ear to crypt walls. The dead whisper magic knowledge. Tiny magic XP per whisper.

documents.title: [Quirky] Scry at the Moonpool
documents.snippet: Stare into the moonlit pool. Visions grant magic insight.

documents.title: [Quirky] Meditate on a Lucid Stone
documents.snippet: Sit and meditate on a lucid stone. Gradual magic understanding.

documents.title: Sea-Witch Charter-Conjure
documents.snippet: Salt-Tongue teaches charter-conjure. Scroll the wind into vellum. Each scroll a one-shot ferry. She pays in repeat custom.

documents.title: Gear-Bound Soot-Cant
documents.snippet: Cast gear-bound enchantments on raw plate stock. Industrial magic. Loud. Bright. Noisy.

documents.title: Rune-Imbue Press
documents.snippet: Press imbue-runes into gear-tokens at the industrial stamp. Peak Sootworks magic.

documents.title: Lunar Spellbook Training
documents.snippet: Lunar spells: cure, vengeance, heal group, NPC contact. Best magic XP + utility.

documents.title: Dream Stalker Burst
documents.snippet: Burst/Barrage dream stalkers. Highest magic XP in the game. Tied for XP/hr record.

documents.title: Mage of Zamorak Battles
documents.snippet: Fight Zamorakian mages in the wilderness. They drop runes. PvP-enabled.

documents.title: Strike Spells
documents.snippet: Auto-cast strikes on safe monsters. Rune cost is minimal. Gentle start.

documents.title: Curse / Low Alchemy
documents.snippet: Cast curse on NPCs or low alch items. Bridges the gap between strikes and high alch.

documents.title: Bolt Spells on Slayer
documents.snippet: Cast bolt spells on slayer tasks. Trains magic and slayer together. Decent loot offsets rune cost.

documents.title: High Alchemy
documents.snippet: Alch items for gold. Profitable with the right items. Can be done anywhere.

documents.title: Burst/Barrage Stacking
documents.snippet: AoE spells on stacked undead. Fastest magic XP. Burns through runes fast.

documents.title: Bolt Enchanting
documents.snippet: Enchant bolts for profit. Decent XP and money. Scales with bolt type.

documents.title: God Spell PKing
documents.snippet: Cast god spells on other players. Requires Mage Arena. Profit depends on kills.

documents.title: [Quirky] Listen to What the Forest Said
documents.snippet: Stand in the Whisper Glade. Do nothing. Hear — eventually — the forest. Magic XP accrues where attention goes.

documents.title: Stag-Stone Forest-Binding Magic
documents.snippet: Bind dryads to the Stag-Stone; they rent their shape — briefly — in return. Advanced magic.

documents.title: The Mage Arena — God Spells
documents.snippet: Mage Arena. Level fifty-six wilderness. God spells — Flames of Zamorak, Saradomin Strike, Claws of Guthix. The arena is a safe pocket. Getting there is not.

documents.title: Zuriel's Staff — Teleblock Cascade
documents.snippet: Zuriel's staff. Teleblock at twenty-percent-less rune cost. Cast on PKers as they approach. The XP is the threat. The threat is the XP.

documents.title: Revenant Ice Burst Range
documents.snippet: Ice Burst into the revenant cave pack. Three revs at once, four if the goblins cluster. Magic XP per cast stacks across the burst radius.

documents.title: [Quirky] Shout at a Passing PKer
documents.snippet: Shout at the PKer riding past the edgeward. A curse, a name, a number. Tiny magic XP. The shout does not stop him — nothing does.

documents.title: Chaos Elemental — Disarm Combat
documents.snippet: Chaos Elemental. Level-fifty-one wilds. Disarms the wielded weapon. Drops unstable orb — random teleport trinket, +10% magic damage inside wilds.

documents.title: Thammaron's Sceptre — Deep Cast
documents.snippet: Thammaron's sceptre. +50% accuracy and damage inside the wilds. Revenant targets. The sceptre drinks ether faster than any weapon.

documents.title: Salt-Cistern Runecrafting
documents.snippet: Cut rune-salt from the cistern wall and press it into the desiccated rune. No running, no chipping. The desert does the work and the wind signs it.

documents.title: Rune-Salt Double-Binding
documents.snippet: Bind salt and water together on the same stone. The prophet calls it the only honest rune. The only one the desert will accept as its own.

documents.title: Singing Glass Crystal-Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Carve the singing glass. Each rune carries its own note. Endgame rune tier. BiS for crystal spellcasting.

documents.title: Light-Rune Binding
documents.snippet: Bind light. The only rune that burns instead of breaks. BiS for endgame combat magic.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Hedge-Wise Gift — once-per-game-week bir
documents.snippet: Hedge-Wise Gift — once-per-game-week birth-name ceremony

documents.title: Hedge Ley-line Runecrafting
documents.snippet: The old hedge runs along a natural ley line. The hedge-wise women let you craft here if you remember your name.

documents.title: Midnight Ley-Weave
documents.snippet: The ley line only shimmers from 00:00 to 00:45 in-game. Sprig held in left hand, pouch in right, ink blot on the forehead. The hedge-wise women call this "weaving proper."

documents.title: Echo Vaults — Dream-Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Dream runes at the Echo Vaults. Mid-tier Lunar-kin. Feeds every Lunar spell in Aelgard.

documents.title: Echo Vaults — Name-Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft runes that call a thing by what it almost was. Required for dreambinding prayers.

documents.title: Moryskah Blood Altar
documents.snippet: Blood runes at the Moryskah altar. THE blood rune source. Cross-region demand (Scythe/Sang charges).

documents.title: Salt-Pan Brine-Crystal RC
documents.snippet: Lay brine crystal on the pans. The sun does the rest. Water runes at 8x yield but you collect once per cycle, not once per minute.

documents.title: Storm-Altar Runecrafting
documents.snippet: The storm-altar rises from the breakwater in heavy weather. Dual-element binding. The altar only shows in a blow — she waits for the wind.

documents.title: Soot-Library Industrial Runes
documents.snippet: Etch industrial runes from forge-crystal at the Soot-Library. Scrolls feed Sootworks magic.

documents.title: Soul Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Soul runes at the Inkweald spire. Highest-tier RC. Ultra-profitable.

documents.title: Sun Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Wrath runes at the Sun Altar. Post-endgame RC. Only source of Wrath spells.

documents.title: Wilderness Pure Essence
documents.snippet: Pure essence mines in the wilderness — 3x yield vs safe regions. PKer threat.

documents.title: Wilderness Abyss Runecrafting
documents.snippet: The Abyss. Fastest runecrafting route in Aelgard. Wilderness entrance. PKers camp the abyss portal. Four skill obstacles through the core.

documents.title: Air Rune Running
documents.snippet: Bank, fill pouches, run to altar, craft. The classic RC grind. Slow but free.

documents.title: Guardians of the Rift
documents.snippet: Minigame provides essence and altars. Low attention entry to runecrafting. Earns runes and outfit pieces.

documents.title: Lava Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Fastest RC XP. Binding necklace + magic imbue + precise banking. Costs a fortune.

documents.title: Blood Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Mine dense essence, chisel, craft at blood altar. AFK and profitable. The endgame chill.

documents.title: Daeyalt Essence RC
documents.snippet: Mine daeyalt first (AFK), then craft for 50% bonus XP. Split attention over two sessions.

documents.title: Abyss Runecrafting
documents.snippet: Run through Wilds to the Abyss portal. Skull risk every trip. Best general RC XP/profit.

documents.title: Mooncourt Lunar Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: At the Mooncourt altar, by moon-tide, runes — cast. Low-attention, profitable, flagship RC escape-hatch from the Misery Zone.

documents.title: Mooncourt Dream-Rune Crafting
documents.snippet: Dream-runes — craft when the altar sleeps. Powers phase-through effects. Low-attention, high demand.

documents.title: Deep-Wild Blood Rune Altar
documents.snippet: Blood rune altar. Deep wilderness. Twenty-eight wilds levels from the nearest glory tab. The only fast blood altar in Aelgard.

documents.title: Deep-Wild Death Rune Altar
documents.snippet: Death rune altar. Level-twenty-two wilderness. Closer than the safe equivalent; twice the PKer risk. Rate holds 2200/hr.

documents.title: Wrath Rune Altar — Deepest Wild
documents.snippet: Wrath rune altar. Level-fifty-two wilderness. Highest RC XP bar in Aelgard. Only crafts inside the Throne pocket. Two tiles to teleblocked safety.

documents.title: Desert-Temple Framing
documents.snippet: Raise a desert-temple frame the old way, with sandstone laid so the shadows cross at noon. The framing is the first thing the sun-warden will see when he dreams of home.

documents.title: Sand-Glass Wall-Craft
documents.snippet: Mount sand-glass panes into granite. The light that enters at sunset casts every wall of the house in the color of dry blood — and yet the dwelling is cool inside.

documents.title: Dunewright Crystal-Glass Framing
documents.snippet: Frame crystal-glass walls at the Dunewright yard. Highest construction XP/hr in Aelgard. Costly.

documents.title: Dunewright Master — Prism Beam Assembly
documents.snippet: Prism beams hold what wood cannot. BiS construction. The house remembers its own shape.

documents.title: Carpenter Apprentice Work
documents.snippet: Help local carpenters build houses. Slow XP but no house needed.

documents.title: [Quirky] Hold the Thatcher Ladder
documents.snippet: The village thatcher works without a helper. Holding his ladder steady grants a trickle of construction. Don't look up when he curses.

documents.title: Cathedral Window Restoration
documents.snippet: Rebuild the chapel's stained windows pane by pane. The monks sing while you work. Time loses its grip.

documents.title: Backseam Camp — Dream-Frame Raising
documents.snippet: Raise a half-true wall. It's there until someone really looks. Then you raise it again.

documents.title: Dream-Oak Pavilion Construction
documents.snippet: Build a pavilion that holds a single idea overnight. POH-tier XP with dream-flavored rooms.

documents.title: Dwarven Workshop
documents.snippet: Dwarven master craftsmanship training. Only region with this method.

documents.title: Mausoleum Construction
documents.snippet: Build a Moryskah mausoleum POH. Tombstone theming. Features gilded-altar equivalent built of cursed stone.

documents.title: Shipwright's Yard Framing
documents.snippet: Hull frames, deck planks, masts stepped. Bulk work. Lay plank, hammer, move. She does not demand cleverness. She pays in footage.

documents.title: Lighthouse Masonry
documents.snippet: Course the tidestone up. Each lighthouse reinforced adds to the signal network. She will not fall — the sea has tried.

documents.title: Crude Wooden Chairs
documents.snippet: Build, remove, repeat. The introductory grind. Cheap planks.

documents.title: Oak Larders
documents.snippet: Butler brings planks, build larder, remove. Fast but expensive. Requires focus.

documents.title: Mahogany Tables
documents.snippet: The fastest construction XP. Mahogany planks are brutal on the wallet.

documents.title: Teak Garden Benches
documents.snippet: Cheaper than mahogany tables but slower. The budget high-level option.

documents.title: Wilderness Fortifications
documents.snippet: Build fortifications at Wilds outposts. Cheaper materials but PKers patrol the area.

documents.title: Sawmill Contracts
documents.snippet: Fill NPC construction orders for profit. Slower XP but actually makes money.

documents.title: Canopy House Construction
documents.snippet: Build a house in the canopy. Elven frame-work; rooms grow, not built. Top-tier construction XP at mid-low cost.

documents.title: Threshold-Lintel Carving
documents.snippet: Carve lintels for the Threshold-Wardens. Each holds a name; each name — remembered. Cheap early construction path.

documents.title: Bandit Camp Barricade Building
documents.snippet: The bandit camp pays in skull-gold for barricade work. Level-nineteen wilderness. Build the wall. The wall is what stops the PKer wave at the gate.

documents.title: Wilds Hideout Construction
documents.snippet: Build your hideout inside the wilds. Peak construction XP. A personal pocket: bank, glory, altar. PKers cannot enter; they can camp the exit.

documents.title: Singing Dunes — Full Course
documents.snippet: The dunes sing when the wind crosses them at the right angle. Run the course between the songs — vault, crest, slide, vault. Miss the tempo and the sand takes you one ankle at a time.

documents.title: Dune-Vault Speed Run
documents.snippet: The dune-vault against the clock. Wind-shift every twelve ticks. No hand-holds. The sand does not forgive a missed beat.

documents.title: Glass-Walker Mirrored Spire Climb
documents.snippet: Climb the Mirrored Spire. The spire holds the climber. The spire does not forgive a slip. BiS endgame agility.

documents.title: Glass-Bridge Endurance Run
documents.snippet: Run the glass bridges between lens-quartz spires. They ring when you land. They break if you hesitate.

documents.title: [Quirky] Walk the Dune-Edge
documents.snippet: Walk the edge where dune meets glass. One foot on sand, one on glass. Tiny agility XP. The desert teaches balance.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sneak Eggs from the Coop
documents.snippet: Old Grigg keeps his chickens alert. Slipping in for an egg without the rooster noticing teaches a little agility.

documents.title: Capital Rooftop Course
documents.snippet: Capital's chimneys, clotheslines, and copper gutters. The guard below applauds when you stick the landing.

documents.title: Bell Tower Free-Climb
documents.snippet: Free-climb the bell tower between the 11 and 12 chimes. The bell itself must NOT ring during your ascent or you fall. One attempt per in-game hour.

documents.title: Pageturn Court — Page-Vault Course
documents.snippet: Run the index of the year. Page-vault; margin-walk. The court re-foliates behind you. Don't look back.

documents.title: [Quirky] Walk the Margin
documents.snippet: Step along the edge of what is written. Do not fall into the sentence. Small agility XP; the margin is narrow.

documents.title: Pyramid Agility Course
documents.snippet: Climb the ancient pyramid. Rare gold pyramid top = 1m gp when sold.

documents.title: Druidic Canopy Course
documents.snippet: Canopy-top parkour between ancient elven platforms. Best mid-tier agility XP.

documents.title: Ship Rigging Course
documents.snippet: Climb ship rigging across the harbor. Falling hurts.

documents.title: Mausoleum Rooftop Course
documents.snippet: Rooftop parkour across the mausoleum district. Gothic-flavored agility training.

documents.title: [Quirky] Climb the Rigging
documents.snippet: Climb the ship rigging. Sailors laugh if you slip.

documents.title: [Quirky] Climb the Fallen Statue
documents.snippet: Climb the ancient fallen statue. PvP-enabled while you do.

documents.title: Piratesfall Rope-Bridge Course
documents.snippet: Rope-bridges, mast-climbs, rope-to-rope traverse. Piratesfall Cliffs. A fall drops you twenty feet into the surf; she does not kill you but she reminds.

documents.title: Rigging-Run Agility
documents.snippet: Rigging-run course on berthed ships. High attention — the rope moves with the swell. Top-tier agility for Saltbrine.

documents.title: Pump Station Pipe-Vault Course
documents.snippet: Pipe-vault, valve-spin, gear-walk, repeat. Eight stops. Miss a beat, scald a shin. Decent XP + marks.

documents.title: Deep Gearwalk Elite Run
documents.snippet: Elite gearwalk deep below the pump station. Tick-perfect. Falls scald for real. Best Sootworks agility.

documents.title: [Quirky] Spin the Pump Valves
documents.snippet: Spin the surface valves for the pump-boys. Arms and legs both. Tiny agility XP.

documents.title: Gnome Stronghold Course
documents.snippet: The starter agility course. Click through obstacles. Free and straightforward.

documents.title: Canifis Rooftop Course
documents.snippet: Short laps, decent marks of grace. Easy money via graceful set pieces.

documents.title: Seers Rooftop Course
documents.snippet: Teleport to start shortcut makes this the best mid-level course. Requires diary.

documents.title: Ardougne Rooftop Course
documents.snippet: Best standard agility XP. Consistent course with no fail points at 90+.

documents.title: Hallowed Sepulchre
documents.snippet: Dodge traps in a crypt. The fastest agility XP by far but demands perfection.

documents.title: Wilderness Agility Course
documents.snippet: Free, fast, dangerous. PKers patrol the course. Bring nothing you cannot lose. Higher XP than Ardougne justifies the risk.

documents.title: Wilderness Agility Course
documents.snippet: Wilderness agility course. Level fifty-two wilderness. The dispenser at the end drops skull-gold. PKers chase runners — the course is the escape and the training.

documents.title: Wilds Shortcut Network
documents.snippet: Every wilds shortcut, in a chain. Skull-Gold to Grave-Mile to No-Honor to Teleblocked Deep. The route the escapers learn. The route the PKers also learn.

documents.title: [Quirky] Count the Ditch Tiles
documents.snippet: Stand at the ditch and count each tile between you and the wall. Twenty-three. Twenty-two. Tiny agility XP. The count becomes a reflex.

documents.title: Boil Pit Heat-Distillation
documents.snippet: The boil pits work the potion by heat alone — no fire needed, the sun is enough. The tinctures they produce are also a one-minute heat-stroke immunity.

documents.title: Salt-Cured Tincture Brewing
documents.snippet: Cure the tincture with salt so it keeps. The sand-warden carries stacks of ten into the deep dunes and does not fear the spoil of the wineskin.

documents.title: Lens Apothecary — Super Combat ++
documents.snippet: BiS combat consumable. Overwrites super combat. The Apothecary does not brew. The Apothecary distills.

documents.title: Prism Elixir Master Distillation
documents.snippet: Distill the elixir through lens-quartz. +15% spell damage, 5 minutes. BiS magic consumable.

documents.title: Apothecary Potion Mixing
documents.snippet: Mix potions at the Heartlands Apothecary. Clean herb + secondary + vial. Bread-and-butter herblore.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Reagent Road replay — farm 23 cross-regi
documents.snippet: Reagent Road replay — farm 23 cross-region reagents

documents.title: Royal Herbalist Laboratory
documents.snippet: The Court Herbalist's bench, under royal license. Nothing waits, nothing spoils. Torstol and whisker make the tonic that keeps the king fit.

documents.title: The Backwards Garden — Reverse-Decay Brewing
documents.snippet: The potion undoes the last ten seconds. You drink it before you need it. The herbs were harvested before you planted them.

documents.title: Lucid Bloom Brewing
documents.snippet: Brew lucidity. Two minutes of perfect clarity. You forget what you thought about.

documents.title: Druid Herb Mastery
documents.snippet: Brew with the druids. Druid circle grants +10% potion yield.

documents.title: Sea Potion Brewing
documents.snippet: Brew sea potions. Unique Saltbrine herblore — fishing + waterbreathing variants.

documents.title: Bog Witch's Apprentice
documents.snippet: Brew with the Bog Witch. Unique swamp potions with undead-resistance bonuses.

documents.title: Brewer's Quay Barrel-Fermenting
documents.snippet: The Brewer's Quay ferments in oak barrels swept by sea air. Sea-medicine. Anti-drowning draught is only made here. Barrel-cooper watches the bubbles.

documents.title: Rust-Pits Pipe-Brewing
documents.snippet: Brew pipe-fungus in oil-moss tonics. Stout-style potions. Soot-Cough cure is Sootworks-native.

documents.title: Vent-Bloom Master Apothecary
documents.snippet: Distil vent-bloom with pilgrim brass into prayer-restore brews. Sootworks super-restore analog.

documents.title: Prism Garden Herblore
documents.snippet: Prism garden grows all herb types. 2x yield means Glass Desert can self-sustain herblore.

documents.title: Attack Potions
documents.snippet: Clean herbs, mix potions. Simple but costs money from buying secondaries.

documents.title: Prayer Potions
documents.snippet: Ranarr + snape grass. One of the few profitable herblore methods. Always in demand.

documents.title: Super Combat Potions
documents.snippet: Combine super attack, strength, defence. Massive XP, massive cost. Endgame money sink.

documents.title: Herb Cleaning
documents.snippet: Click and clean. Profitable, brain-dead, scales with herb type. The AFK path.

documents.title: Wilderness Herb Gathering + Mixing
documents.snippet: Gather Wilds herbs and brew on-site. Free materials but PK risk. Self-sufficient path.

documents.title: Wilds Herb Patch Tending
documents.snippet: The wilderness herb patch. Twenty tiles from a glory. Never diseases. No payment. No protection. The herbs come in stacks that would never grow safe.

documents.title: Anti-PK Potion Brewing
documents.snippet: Brew the anti-PK potion. Reduces incoming PvP damage ten percent for five minutes. Only brews inside the wilds; spoils outside within one tick.

documents.title: Blighted Potion Processing
documents.snippet: Blight the potion. Super restores stack five hundred to a slot. The bulk pays the risk. The risk lives inside the wilds.

documents.title: Hyena Market Gauntlet
documents.snippet: Work the Hyena Markets where the traders deal in the disappeared. Pickpocket the fencemasters. Read the script only if the cipher-tongue is yours. The wind will know if you steal.

documents.title: Sand-Hidden Cache Theft
documents.snippet: Read the sand-script on the dune, dig where it tells you. The caches the fence-kings forgot. The caravan ledgers unlock the sand-warden's lost supply routes.

documents.title: Mirror Library Vault Lifting
documents.snippet: Lift from light-locked vaults. The locks are made of witness. The witness is made of light. BiS thieving.

documents.title: Mirror Library Master Vault
documents.snippet: The Master Vault has never been opened twice by the same hand. The library remembers your touch.

documents.title: Heartlands Market Pickpocketing
documents.snippet: Pickpocket marketgoers. Getting caught = small fine, no real danger.

documents.title: [Quirky] Fish the Wishing Well
documents.snippet: A magnet on a string retrieves copper and silver pieces from the bottom of the market wishing well. The fishwife pretends not to see.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sort the Lost and Found
documents.snippet: The guardhouse lost-and-found has a box of unclaimed coin purses. The captain lets you sort them. A coin here, a coin there. It adds up.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Courier Affair — three-sash run across e
documents.snippet: Courier Affair — three-sash run across every noble house

documents.title: Master Thieves' Circuit
documents.snippet: The route the real thieves work: alderman, envoy, banker, chancellor. No one catches you twice.

documents.title: Thursday Market Pulling
documents.snippet: Thieve the Thursday market when it runs on the common. Three disguises must be worn together: noble coat, wedding ring, apron. Only runs on in-game Thursdays. Guards hate this one trick.

documents.title: Chime Markets — Lift the Chime
documents.snippet: Lift the chime, not the coin. The merchant notices what's missing, not what's taken. Iconic Inkweald thieving.

documents.title: Steal-From-Shelf Thieving
documents.snippet: Steal from the Library that reads back. The shelves remember you. Don't come back the same way.

documents.title: [Quirky] Stack the Chimes
documents.snippet: Stack market chimes in silence. Tiny thieving XP per stack. The merchant never looks up.

documents.title: Pyramid Plunder
documents.snippet: Loot pyramid chambers. Massive thieving XP. Rare drop: Pharaoh's Sceptre teleport.

documents.title: Pearl Diving
documents.snippet: Dive for pearls. Unique thieving method. Pearls feed jewelry economy.

documents.title: Crypt Robbing
documents.snippet: Rob Moryskah crypts. Coin stacks + occasional jeweled grave goods. Risky — mummy guardians wake.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sift the Dig Site Sand
documents.snippet: Sift sand for tiny artifacts. Most are worthless but you learn stealth.

documents.title: Smuggler's Manifest Forgery
documents.snippet: The Smuggler's Hold. Forge cargo manifests, bribe customs, walk the contraband through. High thieving XP. Customs-evasion is the art.

documents.title: Charter-House Pickpocketing
documents.snippet: Charter Houses crowd with travellers. Pick the pockets of the careless merchant. Charter-voucher fragments worth their weight in free ferry.

documents.title: Beggars' Gallery Clerk-Lifting
documents.snippet: Lift pockets off trade-clerks at shift-change. Gallery after hours has no guards. Quiet work.

documents.title: Coal-Throat Strongbox Lockpicking
documents.snippet: Crack strongboxes at the Coal-Throat vaults. Tumbler-sequence minigame. Master-thief work.

documents.title: Paradox Pickpocketing
documents.snippet: Pickpocket the paradox rabbits. They sometimes rob you back.

documents.title: Man Pickpocketing
documents.snippet: Pickpocket men for coins. Pathetic profit, but it is a start.

documents.title: Fruit Stall Theft
documents.snippet: Spam-click a stall. Completely braindead. Fruit is nearly worthless.

documents.title: Blackjacking
documents.snippet: Knock out, pickpocket, repeat. Fastest thieving XP. Demands perfect timing.

documents.title: Ardougne Knight Pickpocket
documents.snippet: Trap a knight, click repeatedly. Semi-AFK with coin pouches. The relaxed money maker.

documents.title: Rogues Castle Chests
documents.snippet: Loot chests in deep Wilderness. Best thieving gp/hr but PKers camp the castle.

documents.title: Court Pickpocketing
documents.snippet: Pick the Hidden Court pockets. Fail — not imprisoned; merely forgotten a day. Court coin purses drop rune-thread.

documents.title: Thinkberry Farm Cache Thieving
documents.snippet: Crack the farmer's cache — stealing thinkberries. Farmer notices; shrugs; re-plants. Early thieving training.

documents.title: Bandit Camp Pickpocket
documents.snippet: The bandits do not protect their own. Pickpocket the camp. Level-nineteen wilderness. Skull appears every five minutes. The bandits cannot see it. PKers can.

documents.title: Wilderness Pyromancer Stall Theft
documents.snippet: Pyromancer stalls at the wintertodt camp-the-outer-ditch. Steal reagents. Thirty tiles from safety. The pyromancers themselves are not your problem.

documents.title: Bone Jewelry Room
documents.snippet: Work king-bone and sand-glass together at the jewelry bench. The rings the sand-warden marries in. The pendants the prophet buries when the wind forgets.

documents.title: Chitin-Armor Assembly
documents.snippet: Rivet chitin-plate to the salt-cured pelt. Light as linen, hard as granite. Only the scarab-keeper knows how the plates marry — and he is old now.

documents.title: [Quirky] Polish the Mirror Lens
documents.snippet: Polish a lens in the Mirror Library stacks. The librarian nods. Tiny crafting XP. The lens remembers clean.

documents.title: [Quirky] Polish the Inn Window
documents.snippet: The south window of the Heartlands Inn stays dusty even after rain. Polishing it grants a trickle of crafting XP. The innkeeper never stops you.

documents.title: [Quirky] Wash the Inn Tankards
documents.snippet: The innkeeper runs out of hands at dinner rush. A slow soak in the wash-tub earns a nod and a crumb of crafting skill.

documents.title: [Quirky] Make Rubbings of the Gate Plaques
documents.snippet: Each gate plaque in the Heartlands names a founder. Rubbing them in charcoal teaches hands and history together. Collectors buy the full set.

documents.title: Guild Master's Bench
documents.snippet: Work the private bench reserved for masters. Never a queue. The light is perfect.

documents.title: Glass-Iron Jewelry Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft glass-iron rings at the Dream Forge. Transparent; they show the ring you wanted to be wearing.

documents.title: [Quirky] Untie Your Shoes Slowly
documents.snippet: Untie both boots, without looking. Retie them with the other hand. The forest makes note. Tiny crafting XP.

documents.title: Desert Glass Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft glass from desert sand. The only region with unlimited sand access.

documents.title: Clockwork Assembly
documents.snippet: Assemble clockwork items. Unique Sootworks craft — mechanical pets, traps, automatic doors.

documents.title: Sootworks Gem Cutting
documents.snippet: Gem cutting. AFK-friendly. Feeds the entire Aelgard jewelry economy.

documents.title: Blood-Imbued Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft blood-imbued equipment. Vampiric — heals 1 HP per hit. Unique Moryskah niche.

documents.title: [Quirky] Masonry Wall Chiseling
documents.snippet: Chisel decorative patterns into the market wall. Never makes it look better.

documents.title: [Quirky] Re-wrap the Mummy Display
documents.snippet: Carefully re-wrap a display mummy. Minimal crafting XP.

documents.title: [Quirky] Tighten the Steam Pipes
documents.snippet: Tighten the endless steam pipe joints. They always leak.

documents.title: [Quirky] Make Crypt Rubbings
documents.snippet: Press paper to tombstones and rub with charcoal. Etchings reveal old names.

documents.title: [Quirky] Tie Knots on the Pier
documents.snippet: Tie bowline, tie clove-hitch, tie carrick-bend. The rope-hand nods. Crafting accrues in the knots.

documents.title: [Quirky] Clean Pearls for the Jeweller
documents.snippet: Polish raw pearls. The jeweller pays you nothing but you learn the craft.

documents.title: [Quirky] Tune the Crystal Wind Chimes
documents.snippet: Adjust the resonance of the crystal chimes. The sage listens critically.

documents.title: Sail-Stitching
documents.snippet: Needle-and-palm work at the sail-loft. Long seams, steady pace. The loft-wife sings without singing.

documents.title: Sharkhide Tanning
documents.snippet: Scrape, salt, stretch, oil. The hide is patient work. Oilskins keep a man warm on the deep-water watch.

documents.title: Pearl-Setting
documents.snippet: Set pearls in gold. Each piece a small dowry. The pearl-cutter drinks tea, measures twice.

documents.title: [Quirky] Grease the Tinker Yard Gears
documents.snippet: Grease the Tinker Yard gears with oil-moss. Tiny crafting XP. The gnomes thank you in silence.

documents.title: Dream Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft dream-stuff into cloaks. Each robe has a random enchantment.

documents.title: Leather Crafting
documents.snippet: Cut leather into gloves, boots, bodies. Cheap and simple. The first taste.

documents.title: Gold Jewelry
documents.snippet: Smelt gold bars into jewelry at a furnace. Costly but fast for the level.

documents.title: Dragonhide Bodies
documents.snippet: Cut dragonhides into bodies. Fast XP, moderate cost. The standard path.

documents.title: Glassblowing
documents.snippet: Blow glass from sand and seaweed. Free if you gather materials. True AFK crafting.

documents.title: Wilderness Tannery
documents.snippet: Wilds tanner charges nothing. Tan hides for profit, but watch your back.

documents.title: Loom Sanctum Silk-Weaving
documents.snippet: Weave court-cloth bolts on the Loom Sanctum's six-beam. Armour grows into the wearer — crafting + crafting + remembering.

documents.title: Glass-Leaf Knapping
documents.snippet: Knap glass-leaves into arrowheads. A palm-sized stone; a slow tap; a clean break. Feeds fletching downstream.

documents.title: Inner Sanctum Crystal Armour Crafting
documents.snippet: Sing the crystal into shape; the shape sings back. Court-cloth lining; shards; moonsong. Endgame crafting.

documents.title: Callisto Bone Armor Crafting
documents.snippet: Craft the bone armor from Callisto bear skin. Prayer-preserving. Wilds-only equip. The skin does not dry right outside the wilds.

documents.title: Odium Ward Shard Assembly
documents.snippet: Three Odium ward shards. Assemble into the Odium Ward. Ranged defensive shield. +20% accuracy with ranged special attacks. Wilds-crafted only.

documents.title: [Quirky] Carve Your Name on the Wall
documents.snippet: Carve your name on the Edgeward wall. Under the names that did not come back. Tiny crafting XP. The wall has room for many more.

documents.title: The Splinter — Bone-Shaft Arrows
documents.snippet: Splinter the shaft from the heap, seat the jackal-tooth tip, whisper the old words. The arrow knows who it was meant for before the fletcher does.

documents.title: Scorpion-Fletching Binding
documents.snippet: Bind the scorpion-fletching at the quill. Lighter than feather, heavier in intent. Ignores the desert crosswind, which is more than most men can say.

documents.title: Bone-Boomerang Carving
documents.snippet: Carve the boomerang from king-bone so it returns to the hand that threw it. Chains between dune targets in the Salt Sea Range.

documents.title: Glass-Glade Crystal Arrow Fletching
documents.snippet: Shaft. Fang. Fletch. The arrow knows its target. Endgame fletching.

documents.title: Glass-Glade Prism-Bow Assembly
documents.snippet: Assemble the prism-bow. Lens, cedar, string. The bow tunes itself. BiS ranged weapon.

documents.title: Bowstring Spinning
documents.snippet: Spin flax into bowstring on the spinning wheel. Produces THE key fletching input.

documents.title: Novice Arrow Fletching
documents.snippet: Fletch basic arrows for the Heartlands militia. Low XP but produces ammo.

documents.title: Capital Bowyer's Longbows
documents.snippet: The capital bowyer's shop, after hours. She leaves the lathe running and a note: 'Pay what's fair.' No one has ever paid unfairly.

documents.title: Dream-Arrow Fletching
documents.snippet: Fletch arrows whose shafts still half-remember the tree. They hum before they leave the bow.

documents.title: Mirror-Bow Fletching
documents.snippet: Shape the bow so it catches the shot back. Mirror-bows fire what-was-aimed-at. +10% vs dream-kind.

documents.title: Crystal Bow Fletching
documents.snippet: Craft crystal bows — endgame fletching. Requires elven rituals.

documents.title: Cursed Bow Fletching
documents.snippet: Fletch cursed bows from swamp willow. Unique — cursed bows do +10% damage vs undead.

documents.title: Driftwood Bow Fletching
documents.snippet: Cure-bent by sea. Salty in the grain. Bends well, takes tarred cordage. The driftwood bow shoots a touch slower but holds in weather.

documents.title: Sea-Cured Bolt Fletching
documents.snippet: Feather the bolts with gannet-oil quill. The sea cures them hard. She flies true in spray.

documents.title: [Quirky] Mend the Nets
documents.snippet: Mend the fisher's net. A knot at each tear, a kindness at each knot. The fletching isn't bow work; it's the family of work.

documents.title: Tinker-Yard Bolt Fletching
documents.snippet: Shape blackroot shafts, crimp pressure tips. Sootworks-unique bolts for crossbow drills.

documents.title: Shot-Caster Assembly
documents.snippet: Assemble shot-casters on the Tinker line. Part fletch, part smith. Industrial ranged weapon.

documents.title: Arrow Shaft Cutting
documents.snippet: Cut logs into arrow shafts. AFK, profitable, brain-dead. Great while watching TV.

documents.title: Yew Longbow Stringing
documents.snippet: String yew longbows. Fast, low attention. Slight loss per bow.

documents.title: Broad Bolt Fletching
documents.snippet: Attach broad tips to bolts. Insanely fast XP AND profit. Requires slayer unlock.

documents.title: Dragon Dart Tips
documents.snippet: Fastest fletching XP in the game. Dragon dart tips cost a fortune.

documents.title: Wilderness Javelin Crafting
documents.snippet: Wilds-only javelin wood. Good XP and profit but you are a sitting target.

documents.title: [Quirky] Polish the Stag-Stone Bows
documents.snippet: Oil the hunters' bows at Stag-Stone. The wood prefers long strokes, said the fletcher — said she nothing else.

documents.title: Singing-Shaft Cutting
documents.snippet: Cut singing-oak into arrow shafts. Knife chooses its grain. Early fletching path — AFK.

documents.title: Morrigan's Javelin Fletching
documents.snippet: Morrigan's javelin. Fletched at the no-honor workbench. Requires revenant ether bound to magic shaft. The javelin only fletches inside the wilds.

documents.title: Wilds Magic Longbow Cutting
documents.snippet: Magic longbows from wilds magic logs, cut at the Edgeward workbench. Peak fletching XP in Aelgard. The logs do not travel outside the wilds unchipped.

documents.title: Runite Bolt Fletching (Wilds Forge)
documents.snippet: Runite bolts at the Edgeward fletch-bench. Bars come from the Wilds Blast Forge. Feathers come from ptarmigan. The wilds makes its own ammunition.

documents.title: Bone Pyramid Slayer Lodge
documents.snippet: The Pyramid master gives four tasks: sand-mummy, glass-scarab, salt-jackal, dust-hound. Each demands a different weapon. Each leaves a different bone.

documents.title: Crystal Hunter Slayer Contracts
documents.snippet: Crystal-hunter contracts from the Edge-Keeper. Hunt what hunts. The desert remembers the hunter.

documents.title: Wyrm Lair Endgame Slayer
documents.snippet: Wyrm Lair deep. The wyrm watches through the lair-stone. BiS endgame slayer rate in Aelgard.

documents.title: Heartlands Novice Slayer
documents.snippet: Novice slayer tasks from the Heartlands lodge. Chickens, rats, cows, goblins. Safe learning.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Tithe replay — seasonal wyvern cull from
documents.snippet: Tithe replay — seasonal wyvern cull from the Deepkeep vault

documents.title: Deepkeep Wyvern Hunts
documents.snippet: The Heartlands keep has a frostwyvern vault. Very few know the door. The master slayer gives the task herself.

documents.title: Sleeper Trails Slayer Tasks
documents.snippet: Slay the named-things-that-shouldn't-be-named. Ink-shaped. Page-spawn. Tasks pay in what the forest forgot.

documents.title: Mummy Slayer Tasks
documents.snippet: Mummy tasks — wrappings feed the cross-region prayer wrap recipe.

documents.title: Moryskah Slayer Tower
documents.snippet: Slayer tower tasks — aberrants, gargoyles, nechryaels, abyssal demons. Best slayer XP/gp in Aelgard.

documents.title: Scuttler Pits Slaying
documents.snippet: Scuttler Pits — brine-troll, salt-vampire, kraken-spawn. Slayer master Anchor-Sworn gives the task. Slayer XP you cannot get elsewhere.

documents.title: Salt-Wraith Hunting
documents.snippet: Salt-wraiths on the drowned lanes. They do not bleed. Silver-tip finishes them. She is a difficult slayer — pays accordingly.

documents.title: Slag Tunnels Clockwork Contracts
documents.snippet: Slayer contracts from the Iron-Tongue foundling. Clockwork gone wrong, golem-spawn swarms, pipehounds.

documents.title: Turael Tasks (Easy)
documents.snippet: Baby tasks from the easiest master. Low XP but introduces the system.

documents.title: Konar Tasks (Varied)
documents.snippet: Location-locked tasks. Forces you to explore. Brimstone keys add profit.

documents.title: Nieve/Duradel Tasks (Efficient)
documents.snippet: Best XP masters. Skip bad tasks, extend good ones. The efficient grinder path.

documents.title: Boss Slayer Tasks
documents.snippet: Kill bosses as slayer assignments. Lower slayer XP/hr but massive drops.

documents.title: Wilderness Slayer
documents.snippet: Slayer tasks in the Wilds with bonus drop table. PKers are the real boss.

documents.title: Corrupted Forest Slayer
documents.snippet: Corrupted forest tasks — vine-haunts, mirror-stags, glass-spiders, moonhawks-gone-wrong. Each a different puzzle.

documents.title: Krystilia Wilderness Tasks
documents.snippet: Krystilia. Wilderness slayer master. Tasks only in the wilds. Points double of Turael. The drops — they keep what they kill.

documents.title: Greater Nechryael Wilds Task
documents.snippet: Greater nechryael. Level-thirty-five wilds pocket dungeon. Soulsplit scroll fragment. Three fragments. The unlock that lets the prayer heal you every hit.

documents.title: Deep-Wild Wyrm Hunt
documents.snippet: Deep-wild wyrms. Level-thirty-five wilderness. Wyrm scales — crafting secondary for the no-honor armor. Krystilia tasks this at rate.

documents.title: Sand-Hawk Falconry
documents.snippet: The sand-hawk knows the name of its quarry before the falconer does. Release, wait, receive. The bird is older than the hand that flies it.

documents.title: Deathstalker Trap-Line
documents.snippet: Lay traps along the dry-arroyo where the deathstalker walks at dawn. Venom-glands feed the herblore tinctures and the fletcher's tip-venom.

documents.title: Ghost-Camel Chase
documents.snippet: The ghost-camels run the dune chain at the hour the wind has a number but no name. Chase them only with water; the dry chase will take you, not the other way.

documents.title: [Quirky] Count the Vultures
documents.snippet: Count the vultures circling overhead. Hunter XP for attention paid. The prophet says if there are ever none, the desert has moved on.

documents.title: Crystal Hunter Falconry
documents.snippet: Loose the crystal-hunter from the glove. It returns with what it has seen. Endgame hunter flagship.

documents.title: Lens-Cat Trap Line
documents.snippet: Trap lens-cats on the dune-shadow line. They focus light. They burn what they do not see. Very rare.

documents.title: Prismstalker Tracking
documents.snippet: Track the prismstalker through seven colors. Each color is a tense. BiS endgame hunter.

documents.title: [Quirky] Sing to the Salt-Singers
documents.snippet: Sing back to the salt-singers. They listen. They do not sing back. Tiny hunter XP. You learn their pitch.

documents.title: [Quirky] Groom the Stable Horses
documents.snippet: Brush the Heartlands stable horses. Unusual hunter XP. Horsehair sells to fletchers.

documents.title: [Quirky] Watch the Heron at the Mill
documents.snippet: The Old Mill heron hunts frogs like a priest reading the hours. If you stay long enough you learn how a thing should stand.

documents.title: [Quirky] Catch Barn Mice with Crumbs
documents.snippet: Crumbs on the tithe-barn floor draw the mice out. The trick is catching one without squashing it. You clip a whisker and let it go.

documents.title: Master Huntsman Circuit
documents.snippet: The Master of the King's Hunt marks your circuit in the morning. By dusk you know every thicket.

documents.title: Ink-Fox Snaring
documents.snippet: Snare ink-foxes at the third turn. Prints fade if you look straight at them. Go sideways.

documents.title: Mirror-Stag Route
documents.snippet: Hunt what you already saw. Only the stag you've already met lets itself be caught. Mirror-hide feeds BIS cape.

documents.title: Name-Stealing Magpie Netting
documents.snippet: Catch magpies that steal the names of small things. Don't speak their take aloud — the names fade.

documents.title: Bat Netting
documents.snippet: Catch Moryskah bats. Bat wings feed Super Restore potions — CRITICAL cross-region export.

documents.title: [Quirky] Feed the Bat Colony
documents.snippet: Toss scraps to the cave bats. They know you now.

documents.title: [Quirky] Observe the Dream Butterflies
documents.snippet: Watch the impossible butterflies. Study their paths.

documents.title: [Quirky] Stare Down the Seagulls
documents.snippet: Stare intently at seagulls. They stare back. Hunter XP somehow.

documents.title: Sea-Bird Snaring
documents.snippet: Set snares on the tern-ledges. Sea-terns take salt-fish bait. Feathers to the fletcher; flesh to the pier-cats.

documents.title: Pearl-Diver Underwater Hunter
documents.snippet: Underwater hunter — set oyster-traps on deep shoals. Unique to Saltbrine. Pearls to crafting, deep pearls to jewelers who only whisper their price.

documents.title: Cormorant-Trained Fishing
documents.snippet: Train a cormorant. Rope at the neck. She dives; she returns with fish. Hunter + fishing hybrid. She pays twice.

documents.title: Clockbeetle Trapping
documents.snippet: Trap clockbeetles where the pipes run warm. Winding carapaces. Armor inlay material.

documents.title: Glowmoth Lantern Netting
documents.snippet: Net glowmoths in the Lantern Mines after the seam lights. Scales feed fletching, dust feeds crafting.

documents.title: Depth-Trout Snare Line
documents.snippet: Run the snare line across the deep geyser. Each snare is bait-timed. Hunter-caught fish, not fishing.

documents.title: Birdhouse Runs
documents.snippet: Set birdhouses, come back in 50 min. Best hunter XP per time spent. Passive income. Requires crafting and hunter levels.

documents.title: Red Chinchompa Trapping
documents.snippet: Set box traps for red chins. Good XP and great profit from ranged trainers buying them.

documents.title: Herbiboar Tracking
