documents.snippet: Track herbiboar through the forest. Best safe hunter XP. Herbs as bonus.

documents.title: Butterfly Netting
documents.snippet: Chase butterflies through meadows. Free, no requirements, no setup. Not fast but zero-cost entry to hunter.

documents.title: Black Chinchompa Trapping
documents.snippet: Best hunter XP and profit. Wilds-only. PKers will find you. Bring escape tools.

documents.title: Glass-Stag Hunter Trail
documents.snippet: Track the glass-stag; cast a feather-snare. Peak hunter XP + pelt drops. Deep-forest ranging.

documents.title: Black Chinchompa Hunting
documents.snippet: Black chinchompas. Level thirty-two wilds. Only hunter content that requires active wilds presence. PKers come for the chinchompas more than the player.

documents.title: Wilderness Ptarmigan Trapping
documents.snippet: Ptarmigan birds. Level-twelve wilderness. Birds migrate through on the hour. Trap-line runs the ridge. Feathers stack five-thousand to the slot.

documents.title: Quarrymaster Sandstone
documents.snippet: Quarry sandstone slabs from the old face. Each slab weighs a man down; the camp offers a lift-cart at a per-hour fee. The mortar at the Desert-Temple Yard wants this.

documents.title: Quarrymaster Granite
documents.snippet: Granite pays the wall-craft. The slab is heavy and the bank is far. The Quarrymaster pays in the sense that you can eat what you carry out.

documents.title: Salt-Crystal Bed Mining
documents.snippet: Pick salt-crystal from the bed below the cistern. The cook wants it, the herbalist wants it, the smelter wants it. The sand-warden wants it last.

documents.title: Prismstone Vein Mining
documents.snippet: Strike the prismstone. It cuts seven ways. Crystal-cored armor substrate. Mid-endgame mining.

documents.title: Lens-Quartz Face Mining
documents.snippet: Strike the lens-quartz face. Clear through. Refractory fires + magic BiS. Higher tier than prismstone.

documents.title: Heartlands Deep Mines
documents.snippet: Mining Guild deep shafts. Free mithril/adamant ore. No PKers, no competition.

documents.title: Dream Forge — Dream-Iron Mining
documents.snippet: Mine dream-iron. The ore fades if you set it down and walk off. Keep moving. Keep holding it.

documents.title: Lunar-Adjacent Crystal Mining
documents.snippet: Mine crystal where the Lunar Plane leaks into the Inkweald. Cycle days yield +50%. Higher tier than Veilwood.

documents.title: Fossil Island Quarry
documents.snippet: Fossil deposits with iron interspersed. Unique — fossils grant prayer XP per bone.

documents.title: Crystal Vein Mining
documents.snippet: Mine crystal veins. The only source of crystal shards for all charging.

documents.title: Runite Shaft Mining
documents.snippet: Mine runite at 85+. Slow but extremely profitable (~300k/hr).

documents.title: Moryskah Silver Mining
documents.snippet: Silver vein + tombstone rubble in the cursed quarry. Moryskah construction material source.

documents.title: Tidestone & Wreck-Iron Mining
documents.snippet: Cliff-cut stone at low water. Rust-red iron from the wreck-line. The tide keeps the hours. She waits.

documents.title: Saltpetre & Lead Mining
documents.snippet: Saltpetre caves, lead reefs. Powder and shot for the Cannon Foundry. The gunner pays by weight.

documents.title: [Quirky] Scrape the Barnacles
documents.snippet: Careened hull, tide out, scrape the barnacles off the keel. Mining XP — the hull is its own small quarry. Shells sell to crafters.

documents.title: Crystal Endgame Mining
documents.snippet: Endgame crystal mining. Lv 92 mining breakpoint. Feeds all crystal gear maintenance.

documents.title: Copper/Tin Mining
documents.snippet: Starter ores next to a bank. Sell or smelt into bronze. The first pick swing.

documents.title: Iron Powermining
documents.snippet: Drop ore as you mine. Fast XP, zero resources. The pure XP method.

documents.title: Motherlode Mine
documents.snippet: AFK mine paydirt, wash it. Random ore output. Nuggets buy prospector outfit.

documents.title: Granite 3-Tick Mining
documents.snippet: Tick-manipulate granite in the desert. Fastest mining XP. Demands perfect rhythm.

documents.title: Volcanic Mine
documents.snippet: Team mining in an active volcano. Good XP, unique rewards. Requires coordination.

documents.title: Wilderness Runite Mining
documents.snippet: Runite spawns in deep Wilds. Extremely profitable per ore but slow and dangerous.

documents.title: Wilderness Rune Rocks
documents.snippet: Rune rocks. Respawn two times faster than any safe zone. Thirteen rocks in the one node. Level forty-six wilds. The mining hoods hide scars.

documents.title: Lava Maze Runite Cluster
documents.snippet: Lava Maze. Level forty-to-fifty wilds. Four runite rocks in a cluster. Teleblocked deep. Escape is agility thirty — pay the ditch to the resource arena.

documents.title: Wilderness Resource Arena Mining
documents.snippet: The Resource Arena. Level-twenty-eight wilderness gate. Seventy-five-hundred coin entry. Bank inside, ores inside, fishing inside. PKer-proof walls. PKer-sized doors.

documents.title: Wilderness Adamantite Belt
documents.snippet: Adamantite belt. Level-nineteen wilds. Eight rocks in formation. The rate is higher than the Mining Guild. The distance to bank is longer than the Mining Guild.

documents.title: Smelter's Bones Forge
documents.snippet: Temper the bar in the sun the way the old kings did. No flame needed above the bones — the light that killed them still lives in the stones.

documents.title: Bone-Bound Iron Smithing
documents.snippet: Bind the bone into the iron, not upon it. The old kings come back into the weapon and walk again, briefly, each time it is swung.

documents.title: Lens Forge — Light-Imbued Smelting
documents.snippet: Smelt the three-stone alloy at the Lens Forge. Light-imbued. BiS smithing bar in Aelgard.

documents.title: Lens Forge — Crystal-Cored Plate
documents.snippet: Hammer the crystal core into the plate. Tier-5 armor. The plate does not dent. The plate remembers.

documents.title: Lens Forge — Prism-Blade Forging
documents.snippet: Forge the prism-blade. It holds its edge on its own. BiS weapon blank in Aelgard.

documents.title: Royal Armoury Commissions
documents.snippet: Forge ceremonial rune armour for the Crown. Heavy concentration, steady pace. Each piece stamped by the master smith.

documents.title: Dream Forge — Idea-Holding Smithing
documents.snippet: Smelt the idea into the bar. Whatever you were thinking when you struck — that's what the bar remembers.

documents.title: Dream Forge — Glass-Iron Working
documents.snippet: Glass-iron. Transparent bars. You can see what the metal was going to become before you made it.

documents.title: Blast Furnace Smelting
documents.snippet: Blast Furnace halves coal requirements. Best smithing XP in the game.

documents.title: Silver-Tipped Forge
documents.snippet: Silver-tipped weapons at the Moryskah forge. Werewolf-slaying BIS.

documents.title: Cannon Foundry Smithing
documents.snippet: Cannon Foundry — forge cannon-balls and sea-shot bolts. Only source of sea-shot. The foundry-master inspects every barrel.

documents.title: Anchor Forge
documents.snippet: Heavy work — anchor chain, every link three times the size of an arrow. Anchors are construction components too.

documents.title: Obsidian Smithing
documents.snippet: TzHaar obsidian smithing. Obsidian gear is BIS in specific niches.

documents.title: Bronze Bar Smelting
documents.snippet: Smelt copper and tin at a furnace. Simple introduction to smithing.

documents.title: Gold Bars at Blast Furnace
documents.snippet: Goldsmith gauntlets triple XP. Fastest smithing method. Bank-furnace sprinting.

documents.title: Platebody Smithing
documents.snippet: Hammer bars into platebodies at an anvil. Straightforward, moderate cost.

documents.title: Cannonball Smithing
documents.snippet: Smelt steel bars into cannonballs. Extremely AFK, always profitable. Slowest XP.

documents.title: Wilderness Anvil Smithing
documents.snippet: Wilds anvil gives 20% XP bonus. Bring bars, smith fast, escape faster.

documents.title: Glass-Glade Dream-Iron Forge
documents.snippet: Smelts cold, hammered warm. The Glass-Glade forge takes the iron's dreams — a bar per dream, a dream per bar.

documents.title: Glass-Cored Alloy Forging
documents.snippet: Fold glass-leaf between iron layers. Three folds; three songs; three names — court-armour base. BIS vs magic.

documents.title: Wilds Blast Forge Smelting
documents.snippet: The Wilds Blast Forge. Fuels on coal the PKers cannot take. Rune bars at double the rate of the Heartlands furnace. Level-twenty wilds zone.

documents.title: Vesta's Sword Reforging
documents.snippet: Vesta's longsword fragments reforged. Two fragments, ether charge, a prayer. The blade degrades on death. The forge knows the name of the last person to hold it.

documents.title: Dragon Platebody Smithing (Wilds Forge)
documents.snippet: Dragon platebody smithing. Only the Wilds Blast Forge reaches the heat. Draconic bar + revenant ether bind. Smithing 92 gate. Peak armor XP.

documents.title: Lens-Fish Pool Angling
documents.snippet: The lens-fish holds still in the pool-water. You see its whole shape before you catch it. Steady endgame fishing.

documents.title: Glass-Eel Trench Fishing
documents.snippet: Hook the glass-eel. It pulls. It knows its trench. Fletching secondary from the spine.

documents.title: Prism-Trout Fall Harpooning
documents.snippet: Harpoon the prism-trout at the fall. Seven colors in its side. BiS Glass Desert fish. Heals 25 HP cooked.

documents.title: Heartlands River Fishing
documents.snippet: Fly-fish the Heartlands river. Produces the core food supply for most of Aelgard.

documents.title: Heartlands Fishing Guild
documents.snippet: Fishing Guild harpoon area. Best pure-fishing method for sharks.

documents.title: Rainy Sunday Lakeside
documents.snippet: The Old Mill pool only runs spirit trout on Sundays when it is raining. Three items from the drowned miller quest must be equipped. Five-hour window per in-game week.

documents.title: Memory Brook Fishing
documents.snippet: Fish what was promised. The brook returns the memory you fed it. Trout taste like a summer you almost had.

documents.title: Glass-Eel Run
documents.snippet: The glass-eel runs when the moon is not looking. You catch them by not watching the line.

documents.title: Oasis Fishing
documents.snippet: Fish the hidden desert oases. Mirage carp heals 10 HP + +5% ranged damage for 5min.

documents.title: Saltbrine Fishing Guild
documents.snippet: Saltbrine coastal fishing. Sharks + swordfish. Primary cross-region food export.

documents.title: Anglerfish Deep-Water
documents.snippet: Anglerfish — overheals past max HP. Essential for endgame PvM.

documents.title: Bog Trout Fishing
documents.snippet: Fish the Moryskah bogs. Bog trout cures swamp rot when cooked.

documents.title: Sacred Eel Fishing
documents.snippet: Sacred eel from blessed pools. Scales used in crafting — demand cross-region.

documents.title: Wreck Coast Deep-Water Fishing
documents.snippet: Boat-only fishing over the sunken fleet. Deep tuna and wreck pike. The wreck knows its drowned — the pike calls them up.

documents.title: Aquifer Ironfin Line Fishing
documents.snippet: Slow-draw line in the aquifer pool. Ironfin bite when the pressure settles. AFK-friendly.

documents.title: Geyser-Skitter Catching
documents.snippet: Time the geyser. Net the skitter. Boils its own meat. Scald a hand, eat hot.

documents.title: Deepwell Cave-Fishing
documents.snippet: Harpoon the deepwell cave-fish. Endgame sootworks fish. Pale. Heavy. Heals strong.

documents.title: Wilderness Dark Crab Fishing
documents.snippet: Dark crabs. Level fifty-two wilds. Heals twenty-two per crab. PKer ambush rate: very high. The darkness does not stop the catch — it stops the escape.

documents.title: Shrimp Netting
documents.snippet: Net shrimp on the coast. The classic start. Nearly free and fully AFK.

documents.title: Barbarian Fishing
documents.snippet: Drop fish, gain fishing + agility + strength XP. The efficient 3-skill method.

documents.title: Monkfish Fishing
documents.snippet: Relaxed fishing with decent profit. Bank is close. The chill money maker.

documents.title: Tempoross (Fishing Boss)
documents.snippet: Skilling boss. Cook, fish, douse fires, dodge waves. Unique rewards plus raw fish output.

documents.title: Dark Crab Fishing (Wilds)
documents.snippet: Best food fish, Wilds-only spot. Extremely profitable. PKer magnet.

documents.title: Moonwell Moon-Trout Fishing
documents.snippet: Cast at the Moonwell. Bait, moonlit — else, nothing bites. Silver-scaled, moon-fat. AFK fishing, elven.

documents.title: Glass-Eel Weir Fishing
documents.snippet: Glass-eels — seen when not looked-at. Watch the ripple, not the water. Cooks into eel-pie for +1 magic buff.

documents.title: [Quirky] Ask the Thinking Carp
documents.snippet: Squat by the Thinking Carp Pool. Ask a question. Wait. Tiny fishing XP — the carp forgave you a rod.

documents.title: Wilds Resource Arena Fishing
documents.snippet: The Resource Arena fishing platform. Sharks at the standard rate, but the ditch is at your back and the bank is ten tiles. Entry fee covers the hour.

documents.title: Salted Cookery — Dry-Cure
documents.snippet: Dry-cure the strip of meat until it keeps. Sand-jerky heals six and does not spoil — the caravan food. The cure is simple; the waiting is the craft.

documents.title: Bone-Broth Kitchen
documents.snippet: Boil the bones all night, add the dry-corn at dawn, let the sun finish the stock. Bone-broth heals twelve and grants one prayer point back per bowl.

documents.title: Salt-Glass Hearth — Crystal-Cured Prism-Trout
documents.snippet: Cure the trout in salt-glass. Heals 25 HP. BiS food in Aelgard. No burn risk above 95.

documents.title: Salt-Glass Hearth — Lens-Fish Carpaccio
documents.snippet: Slice the lens-fish thin. Stack in fives. Heals 18 + 1 prayer. The carpaccio holds the desert-clear.

documents.title: [Quirky] Turn the Morning Bread
documents.snippet: The village baker starts his ovens before dawn. If you arrive at 04:30 in-game time and turn the loaves halfway, he hands you a heel to eat.

documents.title: Palace Kitchen Service
documents.snippet: Cook for the court. Never a burned dish at the palace range. The sous chef nods when you plate.

documents.title: Page-Cap Cookery
documents.snippet: Cook at the Page-Cap fire. You'll forget the recipe halfway through. The dish finishes anyway.

documents.title: Midnight-Melon Baking
documents.snippet: Bake at midnight, exactly. The melons taste like what you wanted to say in a dream.

documents.title: Bog Trout Kitchen
documents.snippet: Cook bog trout at the Bog Witch's fire. Cooked bog trout heals 8 HP + cures poison.

documents.title: [Quirky] Stir the Dough
documents.snippet: Stir the bakers dough. They let you help if you dont eat any.

documents.title: [Quirky] Stir the Bog Witchs Cauldron
documents.snippet: Stir the endless cauldron. The stew never finishes cooking.

documents.title: Salt-Smoked Fish Cooking
documents.snippet: Cure fish in salt-thistle brine, smoke over driftwood. The smoke-house smells of both joy and embalming. Both are correct.

documents.title: Hardtack & Ship's Biscuit
documents.snippet: Flour, salt-water, bake twice, bake three times. Ship's biscuit will outlive the ship. Feeds a crew for months.

documents.title: Grog & Galley Stew
documents.snippet: Galley work. Stew the urchin, ferment the grog. The cook does not taste the grog until after the watch. She is honourable in that.

documents.title: Boil-Floor Steam-Cure Kitchen
documents.snippet: Steam-cure ironfin on the Boil-Floor. No flames. No burn risk above 35. Forge-heat does the work.

documents.title: Pressure-Pot Stout Kitchen
documents.snippet: Pressure-pot stout and cave-fish together. Highest cooking XP in Sootworks. Gears up the combat eaters.

documents.title: Shrimp Cooking
documents.snippet: Cook shrimp on a range. Burns often at low levels. Cheap to practice.

documents.title: Wine Making
documents.snippet: Fastest cooking XP. Add grapes to jugs, ferment. High failure rate below 68.

documents.title: Shark Cooking
documents.snippet: Buy raw, cook, sell. Profitable and fast. The premier endgame money method.

documents.title: Karambwan 1-Tick Cooking
documents.snippet: Spam-click karambwan for 1-tick cooking. Fastest possible XP. Wrist-breaking.

documents.title: Wilderness Campfire Cooking
documents.snippet: Wilds campfires give 20% bonus XP. Bring your own fish. Keep an eye out.

documents.title: Hunters' Grove Game Preparations
documents.snippet: The Grove's spit never stops turning. Apologise to the bones before you salt. Top-tier cooking XP + buff-food source.

documents.title: Thinkberry Pastry Kitchen
documents.snippet: Bake thinkberry pies. Smell drifts — farm children come to watch. Early cooking path with a +1 herblore buff food.

documents.title: Bandit Camp Mass-Cook
documents.snippet: The bandit camp oven never stops. Mass-cook sharks at burn-zero level. Level nineteen wilderness. The camp pays in shelter from the ditch hunters.

documents.title: Blighted Food Processing
documents.snippet: Process sharks into blighted sharks. They stack one-thousand-per-slot inside the wilds. They sour within two ticks outside. The risk of long stays — compressed.

documents.title: Sun-Fire — Magnifier Bow Ignition
documents.snippet: Focus the sun through the shard until the driftwood takes. The fire that the wind knows the name of. No tinderbox in the waste — the sun is your tinderbox.

documents.title: Pyre-Bone Burning
documents.snippet: Burn the camel-bone on the driftwood pyre. The smoke goes up in the direction the wind remembers. Double-skill — firemaking and prayer at once.

documents.title: Refractory Fire Light-Binding
documents.snippet: Bind light to glass-cedar. Burns without fuel once lit. Refractory fires do not ash.

documents.title: Crystal-Imbued Master Burn
documents.snippet: Imbue the burn with lens-quartz. Embers hold crystal. Herblore catalyst. BiS firemaking in Aelgard.

documents.title: [Quirky] Relight the Inn Signboard
documents.snippet: The inn signboard lantern blows out in heavy weather. Relighting it costs nothing. The innkeeper leaves a mug of tea on the step.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Lamplighters Compact — light the cross-r
documents.snippet: Lamplighters Compact — light the cross-region route once per day

documents.title: The Wind in the Reeds
documents.snippet: Burn magic logs with reeds along the lakeshore. The smoke carries the reeds with it; nothing smells finer.

documents.title: Lamplighter Dusk Run
documents.snippet: Light every lantern in the capital in one circuit. Dusk window: 19:30-20:15 in-game. The Voss tinderbox, the apron, and soot from last night's run all required. Miss a lantern, restart.

documents.title: Vigil Lights — Lantern of the Dreamless
documents.snippet: Light the Vigil Lanterns. Each lantern burns at the pitch of the last song you heard. Highest firemaking outside Wintertodt.

documents.title: [Quirky] Hum a Hum-Cedar
documents.snippet: Hum the pitch the cedar wants. The log lights itself. The tiny firemaking XP is an embarrassment to the forest.

documents.title: Foundry Stoker
documents.snippet: Stoke the foundry fires. High firemaking XP + coal consumption.

documents.title: Pyre Log Burning
documents.snippet: Burn shade pyres. Double-skill (firemaking + prayer). Highest firemaking XP outside of Wintertodt.

documents.title: [Quirky] Light the Chapel Candles
documents.snippet: Relight chapel candles as they blow out. Gothic ambiance. Tiny firemaking XP.

documents.title: [Quirky] Poke the Desert Fire Pit
documents.snippet: Stir the embers. Keeps the fire alive for desert nights.

documents.title: [Quirky] Trim the Factory Lamps
documents.snippet: Trim the wicks on the dim factory lamps. Light gets slightly better.

documents.title: Lighthouse Beacon Tending
documents.snippet: Tend the lighthouse beacon. Feed teak and mangrove on rotation. The light keeps ships from the rocks — your XP keeps yourself.

documents.title: Signal-Fire Chain Burning
documents.snippet: Light signal fires up the coast in sequence. Each fire tokens. Tokens redeem at the lighthouse teleport network.

documents.title: [Quirky] Walk the Lantern Round
documents.snippet: Walk the lamp-round with the lamplighter. Light each dock-lantern in sequence. The harbourmaster's relief at the quiet round.

documents.title: Lantern Mine Seam-Lighting
documents.snippet: Light the seam. Mining + firemaking in one rhythm. Ignite the wall, ore cracks free. Dual-skill.

documents.title: Deep-Coal Furnace Master Burn
documents.snippet: Master-burn the deep-coal furnace. Temperature-minigame. Peak firemaking XP in Aelgard.

documents.title: [Quirky] Relight the Shaft Lanterns
documents.snippet: Walk the shaft and relight the lanterns one by one. Soot-smoke work. Tiny firemaking XP.

documents.title: Normal Log Burning
documents.snippet: Light logs in a line. Walk, click, repeat. The simplest grind in the game.

documents.title: Maple Log Burning
documents.snippet: Cheap logs, decent XP. The budget mid-range option.

documents.title: Wintertodt (Skilling Boss)
documents.snippet: Group boss. Chop, fletch, feed braziers, heal. Unique rewards and fun.

documents.title: Redwood Pyre Burning
documents.snippet: Most expensive logs but highest FM XP. Line-burning for the wealthy.

documents.title: Wilderness Bonfires
documents.snippet: Communal bonfires give 40% bonus XP. Bring your own logs. Free-ish but deadly. Beats Wintertodt XP if you survive.

documents.title: Shade Cremation
documents.snippet: Burn shade remains on pyres. Keys unlock chests with unique rewards. Profitable.

documents.title: Singing-Log Bonfire
documents.snippet: Stack the singing-logs; light the pile. Each log joins the last note. Top firemaking XP outside Wintertodt equivalents.

documents.title: Threshold Ward-Bonfire
documents.snippet: Keep the warden-fire. Still there, still breathing — the forest noticed. AFK firemaking with prayer secondary XP.

documents.title: [Quirky] Light the Moth-Lanterns
documents.snippet: Relight the Loom Sanctum moth-lanterns, one by one. The moths prefer warmth to truth. Tiny firemaking XP.

documents.title: Wilds Magic Log Burning
documents.snippet: Magic logs on the long road. The fire burns green in the wilds; blue everywhere else. Firemaking XP per log is the highest in Aelgard.

documents.title: Wilds Pyre — Lava Dragon Bone
documents.snippet: Burn lava dragon bones on magic-log pyre. Double-skill: firemaking and prayer at once. The wilds pyre does not extinguish in rain or teleblock.

documents.title: Salt-Driftwood Wash — Cutting
documents.snippet: There are no trees in the waste, but the old sea left its bones on the long dry shore. Cut the salt-driftwood from the wash. The only wood the desert allows.

documents.title: Petrified-Palm Felling
documents.snippet: The oasis-palms that did not make it are mostly stone now. Felling is slow and the chips taste of ash. But the logs burn longer than anything else in Aelgard.

documents.title: Glass-Cedar Stand Cutting
documents.snippet: Fell glass-cedar with the crystal saw. The cedar does not fall. It crystallizes down. Endgame woodcutting.

documents.title: Prism-Pine Grove Master Cutting
documents.snippet: Cut the prism-pine. It rings like a bell. Lens-quartz chips fall with the logs. BiS woodcutting.

documents.title: [Quirky] Stack the Woodpile
documents.snippet: Organize the town woodpile. Technically woodcutting XP. Really just being helpful.

documents.title: [Grandmaster Quest] Royal Warrant — weekly tour of the three
documents.snippet: Royal Warrant — weekly tour of the three royal parks

documents.title: The King's Forest Rangership
documents.snippet: The king's forester tolerates your axe only if your warrant is current. She checks the seal every morning.

documents.title: Cradlewood — Singing-Soft Chopping
documents.snippet: Chop what the forest hums. Each log holds the last line of the song. Quiet when stacked.

documents.title: Cradlewood — Dream-Oak Felling
documents.snippet: Fell dream-oak. The tree gives you one log and one night of the idea it was holding.

documents.title: Blighted Forest WC
documents.snippet: Chop blighted trees. Unique log types. Cursed pyre logs feed the prayer path.

documents.title: Mangrove & Driftwood Gathering
documents.snippet: Mangrove from the tidal roots, driftwood from the tide-line. The tide-line resets each dawn. Low-attention work, steady return.

documents.title: Black Teak Felling
documents.snippet: Salt-hardened teak. Each trunk a mast. Slow felling, heavy timber. The lumbermen work in pairs — one cuts, one watches the sea.

documents.title: Sap-Wells Fungus-Wood Cutting
documents.snippet: Fell fungus-pylons at the Sap-Wells. Soft inside, hard rind. Burns long when lit. AFK hack-and-lift.

documents.title: Blackroot Lantern-Stand Cutting
documents.snippet: Cut blackroot stands by lantern-light. Sap bottles feed firemaking. Logs feed fletching.

documents.title: Normal Tree Chopping
documents.snippet: Chop trees near a bank. Logs sell for fletching. The gentlest start.

documents.title: Willow Chopping
documents.snippet: Powerdrop willows. AFK XP staple. Logs are nearly worthless.

documents.title: Teak 1.5-Tick Chopping
documents.snippet: Tick-manipulate teak trees. Fastest WC XP. Demands frame-perfect clicking.

documents.title: Redwood Chopping
documents.snippet: Chop massive redwoods. Extremely AFK, high XP per log. The endgame chill.

documents.title: Sulliuscep Chopping
documents.snippet: Run between mushroom spawns in the swamp. Good XP, fossils, moderate attention.

documents.title: Wilderness Ent Chopping
documents.snippet: Ents drop noted logs, no banking needed. Good profit if you survive the PKers.

documents.title: Singing-Tree Saw Camps
documents.snippet: Chop only when the pitch is true — 2× yield per clean cut. Elite woodcutting; trains rhythm.

documents.title: Wilds Magic Tree Grove
documents.snippet: Nine magic trees in one grove. Level twenty-five wilds. Highest density in Aelgard. The bark is marked; the axe knows the mark. PKers know the mark too.

documents.title: Wilds Yew Grove
documents.snippet: Wilds yew grove. Level-fourteen wilderness. Seven trees close-packed. Safer than the magic grove; deeper into the ditch before the first rev.

documents.title: Dry-Cure Field — Three-Row Rotation
documents.snippet: Rotate cactus-fruit, dry-corn, salt-barley. Each returns water to the next row. Fifteen percent more yield than wet-grown. The sand pays its debts.

documents.title: Lens-Glass Plot Rotation
documents.snippet: Rotate prism-fruit through light-grass through crystal-corn. Each row passes light to the next. BiS farming.

documents.title: Crystal-Corn Master Plot
documents.snippet: Grow crystal-corn in light-grass beds. Kernels snap like glass. BiS cooking stock.

documents.title: Heartlands 4-Field Rotation
documents.snippet: Rotate 4 Heartlands fields through wheat → potato → herb → allotment. +15% yield via rotation.

documents.title: Royal Orchard Stewardship
documents.snippet: Tend the crown orchards. The head gardener notes your technique. Slow rotation but premium yields.

documents.title: First Rain Planting
documents.snippet: Plant during the first rain of the in-game day (weather must roll fresh). Seed of the Year is distributed each game-week by the hedge-wise women. Hedge-thorn sprig broken into the soil. Once per day.

documents.title: Half-Forgotten Farms
documents.snippet: Plant at dusk. Harvest before you remember planting. The crops grow in the direction of yesterday.

documents.title: Desert Herb Dunes
documents.snippet: Sun-dried herbs. 15% bonus herblore XP when used — unique desert advantage.

documents.title: Fruit Tree Rotation
documents.snippet: Fruit tree patches. Best farming XP after ranarr rotation. Fruit cooks into premium food.

documents.title: Moryskah Blighted Patches
documents.snippet: Grow swamp herbs in the blighted patches. +25% yield vs normal patches.

documents.title: [Quirky] Trim the Sacred Vines
documents.snippet: Prune overgrown vines. The druids appreciate the help.

documents.title: Tide-Tide Salt-Resistant Farming
documents.snippet: Tide-Tide fields — crops that take the brine. The farmhand waters with half-brackish water and the crop pays her for it.

documents.title: Brine-Fed Kelp Cultivation
documents.snippet: Kelp rafts anchored off the breakwater. Grow in fast rotations. Kelp feeds the herbalist and the cook equally.

documents.title: Steam-Field Heated Trays
documents.snippet: Rotate heated trays through barley, fungus, lichen. Steam-field stays warm. Yield +20% vs surface.

documents.title: Lantern-Lichen Plate Tending
documents.snippet: Tend the lichen plates. Glows faint. Sells to herblorists and magic-inkers alike.

documents.title: Wilderness Ent Farming
documents.snippet: Wilderness ent farming. The ents remember who planted them and do not sway for the PKer. Ent sap heals eighteen and grants one prayer point.

documents.title: Allotment Patch Runs
documents.snippet: Plant seeds, come back later, harvest. Passive XP between other activities.

documents.title: Herb Patch Runs
documents.snippet: Best farming money. 5-minute runs every 80 minutes. Passive wealth engine.

documents.title: Tree Patch Runs
documents.snippet: Plant saplings, pay farmer, check health. Fastest farming XP. Extremely expensive.

documents.title: Tithe Farm
documents.snippet: Active farming minigame. Plant, water, harvest on timers. Free but demands focus.

documents.title: Hespori Boss
documents.snippet: Farming boss. Grows over time, fight it when ready. Unique seed rewards.

documents.title: Wilderness Herb Patches
documents.snippet: Wilds patches yield 50% more herbs. Extremely profitable if you survive the run.

documents.title: Deep-Wilds Herb Rotation
documents.snippet: Rotate the wilderness herb patches — level-twenty-two and level-thirty-eight. No disease, no protection. Harvest at skull and the PKers know.

documents.title: attack 5 — minor
documents.snippet: Steel weapons. First real upgrade from bronze. Scimitars become your best friend.

documents.title: attack 20 — minor
documents.snippet: Mithril weapons. Combat starts feeling efficient. Hill giants become farmable.

documents.title: attack 40 — major
documents.snippet: Rune weapons. The mid-game standard. Rune scimitar defines the early-mid game melee experience.

documents.title: attack 60 — major
documents.snippet: Dragon weapons. After Monkey Business quest, dragon scimitar is the gateway to serious PvM.

documents.title: attack 70 — transformative
documents.snippet: Barrows weapons. Abyssal whip territory. You can now use the best non-degradable melee weapons.

documents.title: attack 75 — major
documents.snippet: Godswords and Dragon Hunter Lance. Endgame melee. Every boss in the game is now fightable with BiS.

documents.title: strength 10 — minor
documents.snippet: Max hits visibly increase. First taste of "I am getting stronger."

documents.title: strength 50 — minor
documents.snippet: Granite maul special attack threshold. PvP becomes accessible.

documents.title: strength 70 — major
documents.snippet: Dharok's full set. At low HP, you can hit 60+ with the greataxe. Changes how you think about HP.

documents.title: strength 99 — major
documents.snippet: Max melee strength. The grind that defines RS. Strength cape gives +4 invisible boost.

documents.title: defence 1 — minor
documents.snippet: Pure builds stay at 1. A conscious choice that defines PvP. Defence is optional — that is the design.

documents.title: defence 40 — major
documents.snippet: Rune armour. Green dragonhide. You stop dying to random mobs. The world opens up.

documents.title: defence 70 — major
documents.snippet: Barrows armour. The endgame defensive standard. Torag, Guthan, Verac, Dharok plate.

documents.title: hitpoints 40 — minor
documents.snippet: Enough HP to eat a full shark and sustain through mid-game bosses.

documents.title: hitpoints 70 — major
documents.snippet: Bossing threshold. 70 HP means you can take a big hit and brew back. GWD becomes viable.

documents.title: hitpoints 99 — minor
documents.snippet: Max HP. Anglerfish can overheal to 121. You are as tanky as you will ever be.

documents.title: ranged 20 — minor
documents.snippet: Willow shortbow. Ranged becomes a real combat style, not just a novelty.

documents.title: ranged 40 — major
documents.snippet: Green dragonhide armour. Yew shortbow. Ranged is now competitive with melee for many encounters.

documents.title: ranged 61 — major
documents.snippet: Rune crossbow. One-handed ranged weapon with shield slot free. Changes the meta for prayer-using fights.

documents.title: ranged 70 — major
documents.snippet: Armadyl crossbow. Crystal bow. The ranged endgame begins.

documents.title: ranged 75 — transformative
documents.snippet: Toxic blowpipe. The most iconic ranged weapon. Fast, venomous, game-changing DPS.

documents.title: prayer 13 — minor
documents.snippet: Protect Item. You keep one more item on death. PvP and PvM risk calculation changes.

documents.title: prayer 37 — major
documents.snippet: Protect from Magic. The first protection prayer. Mages in PvP can no longer freeze-kill you.

documents.title: prayer 43 — transformative
documents.snippet: All three protection prayers. This is THE breakpoint. Bosses that were impossible become farmable. The game permanently changes.

documents.title: prayer 60 — minor
documents.snippet: Chivalry. 15% attack, 18% strength, 15% defence boost. Massive DPS increase if you can sustain the drain.

documents.title: prayer 70 — transformative
documents.snippet: Piety. 20% attack, 23% strength, 25% defence boost. THE endgame melee prayer. All serious PvMers need this.

documents.title: prayer 74 — major
documents.snippet: Rigour. 20% ranged accuracy, 23% ranged strength, 25% defence. The ranged equivalent of Piety.

documents.title: prayer 77 — major
documents.snippet: Augury. 25% magic accuracy, 25% defence. The magic equivalent of Piety.

documents.title: prayer 70 — transformative
documents.snippet: Grand Cathedral offerings unlock. Prayer training speed triples. The gilded altar is the fastest prayer XP in Aelgard.

documents.title: prayer 1 — minor
documents.snippet: Chaos Altar is accessible at ANY prayer level. 7x XP. THE wilderness economy of prayer training.

documents.title: prayer 92 — transformative
documents.snippet: Soulsplit prayer unlock threshold. Heal for 25% of damage dealt. The defining wilds prayer.

documents.title: magic 7 — minor
documents.snippet: Lvl-1 Enchant. Sapphire jewelry becomes Ring of Recoil. First taste of enchanting.

documents.title: magic 25 — major
documents.snippet: Varrock teleport. Free instant travel. The world shrinks. Everything is closer.

documents.title: magic 33 — minor
documents.snippet: Telekinetic Grab. Items behind fences. Wine of zamorak without angering monks. Clever interactions.

documents.title: magic 43 — major
documents.snippet: Superheat Item. Smelt bars without a furnace. Mining + Smithing in one inventory. Huge efficiency.

documents.title: magic 55 — transformative
documents.snippet: High Level Alchemy. Convert any item to coins. The backbone of the entire economy. EVERYTHING has a floor price.

documents.title: magic 70 — major
documents.snippet: Ice Burst (Ancient Magicks). AoE freeze spell. Slayer tasks go from single-target to mass-killing. XP rates double.

documents.title: magic 94 — transformative
documents.snippet: Ice Barrage (Ancient Magicks). The most iconic spell. AoE freeze + massive damage. PvP and PvM endgame.

documents.title: runecrafting 77 — major
documents.snippet: Rune-salt double-binding at the Salt Cistern. The only honest rune in the game, the prophet says. The Boneyard runecrafter's ascension.

documents.title: runecrafting 27 — minor
documents.snippet: Cosmic runes. Required for all enchant spells. Your crafted jewelry becomes enchanted jewelry.

documents.title: runecrafting 44 — major
documents.snippet: Nature runes. Self-sufficient high alchemy. You craft your own nature runes, alch your own items. Full circle.

documents.title: runecrafting 54 — minor
documents.snippet: Law runes. Self-crafted teleports. Total mobility independence.

documents.title: runecrafting 65 — minor
documents.snippet: Death runes. The currency of burst and barrage magic. Slayer efficiency multiplier.

documents.title: runecrafting 77 — transformative
documents.snippet: Blood runes. AFK runecrafting. Profitable. Fuels blood barrage for endgame PvM. The skill is finally worth training.

documents.title: runecrafting 90 — minor
documents.snippet: Soul runes. The highest altar. Used in the most powerful spells.

documents.title: runecrafting 92 — transformative
documents.snippet: Light-rune binding unlocks. The only rune that burns instead of breaks. BiS for endgame combat magic.

documents.title: runecrafting 72 — major
documents.snippet: Name-rune crafting. Mid-tier Lunar-kin RC. Feeds Dream-warding prayers and Library magic simultaneously.

documents.title: runecrafting 77 — transformative
documents.snippet: Blood rune crafting at the Moryskah altar. Profitable rune training + feeds Scythe/Sanguinesti upkeep. The iconic RC breakpoint.

documents.title: runecrafting 77 — major
documents.snippet: Salt-Pan runecrafting paired with Moryskah blood altar — the Aelgard RC endgame. Water rune at scale. Cross-region: Salt-Pan feeds the charter-conjure economy across all ports.

documents.title: runecrafting 25 — major
documents.snippet: Soot-Library opens. Industrial runes (soot-cant scrolls) craft 2x per forge-crystal. Sootworks magic comes online.

documents.title: runecrafting 90 — transformative
documents.snippet: Soul rune crafting in Inkweald. Most profitable RC method. Cross-region endgame magic demand.

documents.title: runecrafting 52 — transformative
documents.snippet: Lunar rune crafting. After weeks of the RC treadmill, the Mooncourt altar opens. Low-attention, profitable — the Veilwood escape hatch.

documents.title: runecrafting 95 — transformative
documents.snippet: Wrath rune altar unlocked. Deepest wild. Level-fifty-two wilderness. Two tiles to the throne pocket. The only wrath rune source in Aelgard.

documents.title: construction 20 — minor
documents.snippet: First house rooms. You have a HOUSE. It is empty and sad but it is yours.

documents.title: construction 50 — major
documents.snippet: Portals in your house. Teleport to major cities from your own home.

documents.title: construction 67 — transformative
documents.snippet: Gilded altar with two incense burners. 3.5x prayer XP. The reason most people train construction.

documents.title: construction 82 — major
documents.snippet: Jewellery box (ornate). All teleport jewelry in one interface. Never carry jewelry again.

documents.title: construction 83 — transformative
documents.snippet: Rejuvenation pool (ornate). Restore HP, prayer, stats, special attack, run energy. Between every trip.

documents.title: agility 60 — major
documents.snippet: Dune-vault speed run opens. The sand becomes a musical instrument. The marks of grace rain down if the tempo holds.

documents.title: agility 10 — minor
documents.snippet: Run energy restores faster. The world stops feeling sluggish.

documents.title: agility 40 — minor
documents.snippet: Several key shortcuts unlock. The Falador dungeon shortcut saves minutes per trip.

documents.title: agility 70 — major
documents.snippet: Most endgame shortcuts accessible. God Wars Dungeon shortcut. Bossing efficiency jumps.

documents.title: agility 92 — major
documents.snippet: Hallowed Sepulchre floor 5. The best agility training in the game and one of the best money-makers.

documents.title: agility 75 — major
documents.snippet: Deep gearwalk unlocked. 80k agility XP/hr + pumpman seals. The tick-perfect endgame Sootworks course.

documents.title: agility 52 — major
documents.snippet: Wilderness agility course opens. The one-way escape route. The dispenser at the end drops skull-gold each lap.

documents.title: agility 70 — major
documents.snippet: Wilds shortcut network fully usable. Every shortcut chained into one route. Escape becomes a skill the agility-capped keep.

documents.title: herblore 3 — minor
documents.snippet: Attack potions. Your first potion. Herblore stops being a mystery.

documents.title: herblore 38 — transformative
documents.snippet: Prayer potions. The most important potion in the game. Sustains protection prayers. Changes ALL bossing.

documents.title: herblore 45 — minor
documents.snippet: Super attack potions. 5 + 15% attack boost. The super potion series begins.

documents.title: herblore 63 — major
documents.snippet: Super restores. Restores prayer AND all stats. The premier sustain potion for bossing.

documents.title: herblore 69 — major
documents.snippet: Antifire potions. Required to fight dragons. Without this, dragonfire kills you. Whole boss category unlocked.

documents.title: herblore 81 — major
documents.snippet: Saradomin brews. Heals 16 per dose. The endgame healing potion paired with super restores.

documents.title: herblore 90 — major
documents.snippet: Overloads (if raids herblore). The ultimate combat potion. Boosts all combat stats massively.

documents.title: herblore 92 — transformative
documents.snippet: Prism elixir distills. +15% spell damage for five minutes. The BiS magic consumable in Aelgard.

documents.title: thieving 28 — minor
documents.snippet: Fruit stalls. Good XP, zero attention. Your first real AFK skilling method.

documents.title: thieving 55 — minor
documents.snippet: Blackjacking. The highest thieving XP/hr in the game. Requires insane clicking.

documents.title: thieving 91 — major
documents.snippet: Master farmers become very profitable. Rare herb seeds every few pickpockets.

documents.title: thieving 50 — major
documents.snippet: Coal-Throat strongboxes open. 140k/hr coin + cinderbar ingots. The iconic Sootworks thieving money grind.

documents.title: crafting 10 — minor
documents.snippet: Spinning flax into bowstrings. Your first cross-skill connection. Crafting feeds Fletching.

documents.title: crafting 20 — minor
documents.snippet: Cut sapphires. Gem cutting begins. Uncut gems from mining become cut gems for jewelry.

documents.title: crafting 43 — minor
documents.snippet: Diamond jewelry. The first serious crafting money. Diamond rings, necklaces, amulets.

documents.title: crafting 63 — major
documents.snippet: Green dragonhide bodies. The profitable crafting method. Buy hides, craft bodies, alch or sell.

documents.title: crafting 84 — major
documents.snippet: Dragonstone amulets and fury amulets. The best combat amulet you can make.

documents.title: crafting 80 — major
documents.snippet: Inner Sanctum crystal armour crafting. Endgame armour path — crystal shards meet court-cloth meet moonsong. Veilwood's crafting peak.

documents.title: fletching 1 — minor
documents.snippet: Arrow shafts. 15 per log. Your first batch processing — logs become ammunition.

documents.title: fletching 50 — minor
documents.snippet: Maple shortbow. The efficient fletching training tier. Cut, string, repeat.

documents.title: fletching 70 — major
documents.snippet: Yew longbow. THE classic high-alch item. Yew logs -> yew longbow (u) -> string -> alch = profit.

documents.title: fletching 85 — minor
documents.snippet: Magic longbow. Highest fletching product. Magic logs -> magic longbow -> alch for max gold.

documents.title: fletching 72 — major
documents.snippet: Crystal bow fletching. ONLY source of crystal bows in Aelgard. Endgame ranged weapon start.

documents.title: slayer 1 — minor
documents.snippet: Slayer begins. The skill that makes combat structured. Kill assignments, earn points, unlock new monsters.

documents.title: slayer 55 — transformative
documents.snippet: Slayer helm craftable. 16.67% accuracy and damage boost on task. Slayer becomes THE combat training method.

documents.title: slayer 72 — minor
documents.snippet: Skeletal wyverns. First serious slayer money-maker. Drops are worth millions per task.

documents.title: slayer 85 — major
documents.snippet: Abyssal demons. Drops the Abyssal Whip — the iconic weapon. This is the goal people grind slayer for.

documents.title: slayer 91 — major
documents.snippet: Cerberus. Drops primordial, pegasian, eternal crystals. BiS boots for all 3 combat styles.

documents.title: slayer 95 — transformative
documents.snippet: Hydra. Alchemical Hydra drops Hydra claw (Dragon Hunter Lance component). Best slayer gp/hr.

documents.title: slayer 40 — major
documents.snippet: Moryskah Slayer Tower access. Aberrants, gargoyles, nechryaels — the mid-game slayer grind core.

documents.title: slayer 50 — major
documents.snippet: Scuttler Pits slayer tier open. Anchor-Sworn gives the first salt-wraith task. The Reach's slayer ladder begins here — brine-troll to salt-vampire to salt-wraith.

documents.title: hunter 65 — major
documents.snippet: Ghost-camel chase unlocks. The dune chain at the hour the wind has no name. The camels drop pyre-bones, which burn for prayer.

documents.title: hunter 53 — major
documents.snippet: Chinchompas. Stackable ranged weapon. AoE ranged training in dungeons. Ranged training gets 3x faster.

documents.title: hunter 73 — major
documents.snippet: Black chinchompas. Best ranged XP in the game (via chinning). Caught in the Wilds — PvP risk for PvM reward.

documents.title: hunter 75 — major
documents.snippet: Crystal-hunter falconry opens. The crystal-hunter returns with what it has seen. Endgame hunter flagship.

documents.title: mining 15 — minor
documents.snippet: Iron ore. First ore worth smelting solo. Power-mining iron becomes the go-to training method for years.

documents.title: mining 30 — major
documents.snippet: Coal. The key ingredient for steel, mithril, adamant, and rune bars. Opens the Smithing web.

documents.title: mining 55 — minor
documents.snippet: Mithril ore. First "valuable" ore. Mining starts generating real money.

documents.title: mining 70 — minor
documents.snippet: Adamantite ore. Serious mining money. You feel rich for the first time.

documents.title: mining 85 — major
documents.snippet: Runite ore. The rarest ore. Two rocks in the Wilds, contested 24/7. Mining becomes PvP.

documents.title: mining 90 — transformative
documents.snippet: Crystal mining cap reached. Prismstone + lens-quartz unlock the full Lens Forge chain. The desert yields its clear.

documents.title: mining 75 — major
documents.snippet: Lunar-adjacent crystal mining. Moon-cycle bonus yield. Higher tier than Veilwood. Inkweald becomes the crystal king.

documents.title: mining 92 — major
documents.snippet: Crystal endgame mining. Post-mastery mining. Crystal dust feeds all endgame crystal gear.

documents.title: mining 85 — major
documents.snippet: Wilderness rune rocks accessible. Two-times the respawn rate of any safe zone. Thirteen rocks in a node. Level-forty-six wilderness pocket.

documents.title: smithing 15 — minor
documents.snippet: Iron bars. The 50% fail chance creates early frustration that Ring of Forging solves — your first "I need another skill."

documents.title: smithing 30 — minor
documents.snippet: Steel bars. Steel platebodies for alching. Smithing starts feeding the economy.

documents.title: smithing 50 — minor
documents.snippet: Mithril bars. Mithril platebodies are a real product. You can make gear other players want.

documents.title: smithing 85 — major
documents.snippet: Runite bars. You can smelt the highest-tier bar. Rune platebody smithing is the endgame flex.

documents.title: smithing 99 — major
documents.snippet: Rune platebody. The iconic smithing goal. 5 runite bars. The original flex.

documents.title: smithing 30 — major
documents.snippet: Blast Furnace access. Smithing XP rate triples. Halves coal requirements. Sootworks prestige.

documents.title: smithing 55 — major
documents.snippet: Cannon Foundry unlocks sea-shot bolts. The only source in Aelgard. Ranged economy shifts — the crow's nest demands sea-shot; the Foundry demands smithing.

documents.title: smithing 90 — major
documents.snippet: Vesta reforging threshold. The Wilds Blast Forge accepts the fragments. Peak melee lineage begins.

documents.title: fishing 20 — minor
documents.snippet: Fly fishing (trout/salmon). Active but fast. The best early training method for any gathering skill.

documents.title: fishing 40 — minor
documents.snippet: Lobsters. First fish that heals well in combat. You can now sustain through real fights.

documents.title: fishing 62 — major
documents.snippet: Monkfish. Heals 16. The efficient PvM food. Balance of cost and healing.

documents.title: fishing 76 — major
documents.snippet: Sharks. Heals 20. The iconic endgame food. "Bank full of sharks" means you are ready for anything.

documents.title: fishing 82 — major
documents.snippet: Anglerfish. Heals above max HP. The only food that overheals. Endgame PvM and PvP staple.

documents.title: fishing 82 — major
documents.snippet: Anglerfish fishing. Overheal food that pushes past max HP. Essential for endgame bossing.

documents.title: cooking 40 — minor
documents.snippet: Lobsters without burning (at the Cooking Guild). Reliable mid-game food production.

documents.title: cooking 80 — major
documents.snippet: Sharks. Cook without burning at 99, but even at 80 the burn rate is low enough to profit.

documents.title: cooking 84 — minor
documents.snippet: Anglerfish. The overheal fish. Cooking these for yourself is a point of pride.

documents.title: cooking 70 — major
documents.snippet: Palace Kitchen service opens. Court food is never burned. The palace range cooks perfectly every time.

documents.title: firemaking 30 — minor
documents.snippet: Willow logs. The efficient firemaking training tier.

documents.title: firemaking 50 — major
documents.snippet: Access to the Wintertodt minigame. Firemaking goes from "why bother" to "this is actually fun."

documents.title: firemaking 70 — transformative
documents.snippet: Deep-coal furnace unlocked. 245k firemaking XP/hr. Sootworks becomes the fastest firemaking region in Aelgard.

documents.title: woodcutting 15 — minor
documents.snippet: Oak trees. First tree worth cutting. Oak logs feed construction and fletching.

documents.title: woodcutting 30 — minor
documents.snippet: Willow trees. The AFK woodcutting standard. You will cut willows for hours.

documents.title: woodcutting 60 — major
documents.snippet: Yew trees. Real money from woodcutting. Yew logs for fletching -> longbows -> high alch = profit pipeline.

documents.title: woodcutting 75 — minor
documents.snippet: Magic trees. The slowest, most valuable logs. Magic longbows are the best alch item in the game.

documents.title: farming 9 — minor
documents.snippet: Guam seeds plantable. The herblore pipeline begins. Farm -> herb -> potion -> combat.

documents.title: farming 32 — major
documents.snippet: Ranarr seeds. The money herb. Each ranarr herb run is 50k-100k profit. Farming funds everything.

documents.title: farming 62 — minor
documents.snippet: Snapdragon seeds. Higher profit, higher herblore value. Super restores become self-sufficient.

documents.title: farming 85 — minor
documents.snippet: Torstol seeds. The highest herb. Saradomin brew ingredients from your own farm.

documents.title: farming 32 — major
documents.snippet: Ranarr seeds via Heartlands rotation. THE farming money breakthrough — each run nets ~80k profit at this level.

documents.title: The Heartlands
documents.snippet: The safe starter kingdom. All players begin here. Medieval towns, farms, guilds, a river.

documents.title: The Boneyard Wastes
documents.snippet: Post-apocalyptic desert. Pyramids, fossils, sand elementals. Hot climate damages unprepared players.

documents.title: Veilwood
documents.snippet: Enchanted elven forest. Dense canopy, hidden paths, druid circles. Requires agility to navigate.

documents.title: The Sootworks
documents.snippet: Clockwork industrial underground. Dwarven forges, steam vents, mechanical puzzles.

documents.title: Moryskah
documents.snippet: Gothic horror swamp. Undead, werewolves, vampires. Holy items provide protection.

documents.title: The Inkweald
documents.snippet: Surreal dream forest. Reality bends. Magic-heavy region — melee is unreliable here.

documents.title: Saltbrine Reach
documents.snippet: Pirate coast. Ships, smugglers, deep-sea fishing. Water travel hub.

documents.title: The Glass Desert
documents.snippet: Crystalline wasteland. The hardest region. Crystal Wyrm lives here. Endgame bosses and resources.

documents.title: The Wilds
documents.snippet: Lawless PvP zone north of Aelgard. No requirements to enter, but anything you carry can be taken. Superior training methods and rare resources justify the risk.

documents.title: The Drifting Market
documents.snippet: Player-accessible mobile trade hub. Moves between regions weekly. The GE alternative.

documents.title: Champions' Guild
documents.snippet: Requires quest points to enter. Sells rune platebody. Gateway to Dragon Slayer equivalent.

documents.title: Heartlands Mining Guild
documents.snippet: Rich ore deposits. Mithril and adamant rocks. Invisible +7 mining level boost.

documents.title: Heartlands Cooking Guild
documents.snippet: Best cooking range in the game (lower burn rate). Rare ingredient shop.

documents.title: Heartlands Crafting Guild
documents.snippet: Spinning wheel, pottery oven, and gem cutting station all in one building.

documents.title: Warriors' Guild
documents.snippet: Earn warrior guild tokens. Buy defenders — crucial off-hand for melee.

documents.title: Veilwood Canopy Hunting Grounds
documents.snippet: High-level hunter area above the forest floor. Rare chinchompas and moonhawks.

documents.title: Veilwood Druid Circle
documents.snippet: Sacred grove. Herblore and farming training with elven bonuses.

documents.title: Veilwood Inner Sanctum
documents.snippet: Heart of the elven forest. Crystal-enhanced magic training. Prerequisite for Prifddinas equivalent.

documents.title: Sootworks Blast Furnace
documents.snippet: Halves coal requirements for smelting. Best smithing XP/hr but requires constant attention.

documents.title: Sootworks Deep Mines
documents.snippet: Runite ore deposits, gem rocks, and the entrance to the metal dragon den.

documents.title: Moryskah Slayer Tower
documents.snippet: Multi-floor slayer dungeon. Aberrant spectres, gargoyles, nechryaels, abyssal demons.

documents.title: The Barrows
documents.snippet: Six ancient warrior tombs. Repeatable boss encounters. Drops degradable set equipment.

documents.title: Castle Malachar
documents.snippet: Vampire stronghold. Late-game Moryskah content. Theatre of Blood equivalent raid.

documents.title: Boneyard Pyramid Interior
documents.snippet: Ancient pyramid dungeon. Agility course, prayer training, and access to Ancient Magicks.

documents.title: Saltbrine Deep Waters
documents.snippet: High-level fishing. Anglerfish, dark crabs. Accessed by charter ship.

documents.title: Smuggler's Cove
documents.snippet: Black market shop. Higher sell prices but requires Thieving to access.

documents.title: Crystal Caverns
documents.snippet: Crystal Wyrm lair. Tier 5 endgame boss. The hardest solo encounter in Aelgard.

documents.title: The Fight Caves
documents.snippet: 63 waves of combat. Fire Cape reward. The prestige challenge of Aelgard.

documents.title: The Inferno
documents.snippet: 69 waves. The hardest content in the game. Infernal Cape. Requires Fire Cape to enter.

documents.title: Revenant Caves
documents.snippet: Multi-combat PvP dungeon. Revenants drop unique PvP weapons. Extremely dangerous.

documents.title: Wilderness Resource Area
documents.snippet: Dark crabs, runite ore, magic trees. 7,500gp entry fee. Deep wilderness.

documents.title: Tentacle whip
documents.snippet: Consumes an Abyssal Whip on creation. Destroyed when depleted. Keeps abyssal demons relevant.

documents.title: Dharok's greataxe
documents.snippet: Barrows equipment degrades over time. Repair at Bob or a POH armor stand.

documents.title: Guthan's warspear
documents.snippet: Guthan set heals on hit — incredible sustain for slayer, but degrades.

documents.title: Scythe of Malachar
documents.snippet: BIS melee for large monsters (3-tile hit). Costs ~7.5M gp/hr to use. Only worth it at profitable bosses.

documents.title: Sanguinesti staff
documents.snippet: BIS magic weapon. Heals on hit. Costs ~5M gp/hr. Makes non-degradable trident relevant for budget bossing.

documents.title: Crystal bow
documents.snippet: Reverts to seed when depleted. Recharge with Crystal shards from Veilwood.

documents.title: Arclight
documents.snippet: BIS against ALL demons. Cheap to run but charges are limited. Forces you to choose when to use it.
